σποδονιτροποιός.definition: maker of soap from potash, dub. in MAMA3.546

σπονδαύλης.definition: playing the flute at a CIG2915 , 2983 , IG14.617

σπονδειοπαράληκτος.definition: of a verse with a spondee before the last syllable, Tz. in An.Ox.3.311

σπονδήσιμος.definition: of or for a drink-offering, Philem.67

στοιχειόω.definition: instruct in the basic principles , Chrysipp.Stoic.2.39, Phot.:—Pass., will be instructed, Ael.Tact. Prooem.5, cf. Ath.Mech.5.5

στοιχείωμα.definition: elementary or basic principle, Epicur.Ep.1p.4U., Phld.Rh.1.140S

στοιχείωσις.definition: teaching, Hierocl.in; doctrine of the elements, Gal.7.678, 15.175, 19.356

στοιχειωτής.definition: teacher of elements, of Grammarians, regarded as creators of language, A.D.Synt.309.5, Sch.Hermog.inRh.7.903 W.; the arranger of the letters of the alphabet, Sch.D.T.p.492 H.; of Euclid, the author of the Elements, El…

στολάρχης.definition: commander of a fleet, PCair.Zen.48.2 , Epigr.Gr.337 , PSI4.298.15 , Hsch.; fem. epith. of Isis, POxy. 1380.8

στολίζω.definition: equip, dress, Anacreont.15.29; Plu.2.366f; Stud.Pal.22.183.90 :— Pass., armed with spear, E.Supp.659; Id.IA255 ; Ach.Tat.3.7; LXXEs.8.15: abs., in full dress, ib.1 Es.1.2, al

στόλισμα.definition: equipment, garment, E.Hec.1156, Stud.Pal.22.183.45 , etc., prob. in PTeb.598

στολισμός.definition: equipping, dressing, OGI56.4; equipment, dress, LXX2 Ch.9.4, al., Aristeas96, BGU 1.3 , Pap. in Sitzb.Heidelb. Akad.1923.18;= pectorale, Gloss

στολιστήριον.definition: place where the priests attired themselves or the statues of the gods, vestry, Plu.2.359a, BGU338.1, al

στολιστής.definition: = LXX4 Ki.10.22, Plu.2.366f, Wilcken Chr.77 ii 8 , IG3.140, Jul.Laod.inCat.Cod.Astr.5.189, cj. in Luc.Sacr.14

στολμός.definition: = equipment, raiment, E.Supp.1055; but mostly with a word added, A.Ch.29 ; E.Alc.216 , cf. 923 ; ib.818; also . . over the body, Id.Andr.148; also of chaplets, Id.Tr.258 , cf. HF526; also of sails, A.Supp.715

στομαλίμνη.definition: like salt-water lake, lagoon, Str.4.1.8, 13.1.31; v.l. in Il.6.4

στόμαργος.definition: noisily prating, loud-tongued, A.Th.447, S.El.607; wearisome talkativeness, E.Med.525:—the forms also and are cited as vv.ll. for or by Diosc. Gloss. and others ap.Gal.19.141, 142

στομαυλέω.definition: mimic a flute with the lips, Pl.Cra.417e, cf. Poll.2.101

στομαχικεύομαι.definition: to be disordered in the stomach, Aët.3.109

στόμαχος.definition: neck of the bladder, Hp.Aër.9; or of the uterus, Id.Mul.1.18, Steril.217; Id.Mul.1.36

στομόω.definition: muzzle or gag, Hdt.4.69:—Pass; furnish with a mouth or opening, Poll.2.100

στομφασμός.definition: creation of a mouth-filling word, as for Eust.1123.41, 1350.24

στόμωμα.definition: hardened iron, steel, Cratin.247, Daimach.4J., cf. LXXSi.34.26; Arist.Mete.383a33, cf. Plu.2.510f, 625b, 693a; Id.Lyc.9; hard edge or point welded into a blade or shaft, or steel for this purpose, PCair.Zen.782 .6,64,…

στοναχή.definition: groaning, wailing, Il.24.512,696, Od.16.144; E.Ph.1499 : pl., groans, sighs, Il.2.39, al., Pi.N.10.75, S.Aj.203, etc.; E.Andr.1037 ; so AP7.142

στοχάζομαι.definition: Pl Grg.465a, etc.: impf; metaph., aim at, endeavour after, Hp.VM9; Pl.Grg.465a; Id.R.462a; Id.Lg.962a; M.Ant.8.20; Arist.EN1128a6; Id HA l.c.; aim at having them as judges, X.Cyr.8.2.27; so Plb.6.16.5; LXX2 Ma.14.8; a…

στοχαστής.definition: diviner, LXXIs.3.2; one who aims at, Ph.1.10

στραγγαλιά.definition: induration in the limbs, esp. caused; = Ptol.Tetr.200, Hsch., Gloss.: metaph., LXXIs.58.6

στραγγαλόομαι.definition: Pass., to be twisted or knotted up, Ph.Bel.57.42; is curled tight, Alex.Aphr.Pr.1.76

στραγγεύομαι.definition: Med., loiter, delay; coming slowly, Orib.Fr.138

στραγγίζω.definition: squeeze out, Dsc.1.30; Med., = Sch.Il.15.511, EM729.50: Act. in same sense, Sch.Od.12.351

στραγγουρία.definition: Ion. strangury, Hp.Aph.3.16 , al., Ar.V.810, Pl.Ep.358e, Thphr.HP7.6.3, Aret.CA2.9

στρατάρχης.definition: general of an army, = A.Fr.182 , Hdt.3.157, 8.44, Ph.2.533; gen. restd. in OGI519.16

στραταρχία.definition: office or dignity of general, Ph.2.90, Vett.Val.194.19

στράτευμα.definition: expedition, campaign; armament, army, host, Hdt.7.48; . . OGI453.10 , cf. LXX1 Ma.9.34, al.; Ostr.1595 , cf. Ev.Luc.23.11, BGU1564.5 ; A.Pers.469; i.e. composed of Asiatic mercenaries, Hermipp.58; X.Cyr.3.3.26; IdHG5.…

στρατευσείω.definition: Desiderat. to be anxious for war, D.C.53.25, Fr.40.33

στρατεύσιμος.definition: fit for military service, serviceable, X.HG6.5.12, J.AJ2.15.1; X.Cyr.1.2.4; Plb.6.19.6: Subst. payment in lieu of military service, PMonac. 1.54

στρατεύω.definition: advance with an army or fleet; Med., serve in the army, the following have joined the army for the first time, IG7 l.c.; to join the army, UPZ110.162 , cf. Sammelb. 7354.6 , BGU1680.9 ; the Greeks who are in the army,…

στρατηγέω.definition: Dor. SIG 421.16 (Thermum, iii; c. gen., to be general of an army, etc., Hdt.1.34, 5.102, etc.; freq. in Att., Th.1.29, D.20.82, etc.; also Plu.Per.26; D.H.3.22 ; S.Aj.1100

στρατήγημα.definition: act of a general, esp. piece of; trick, device, Cic.Att.5.2.2, Plu.2.755d; trick of speech, D.H.Rh.9.8

στρατηγία.definition: Ion. office of general; at Athens, office of Ar.Pl.192, Aeschin.2.41: in pl., Pl.Ap.36b, R.599c, etc.; Plu.Per.16: presidency of the Achaean league, Plb.4.37.1, etc.; in Egypt, office of PEnteux.63.10 , UPZ108.28 ; al…

στρατηγιάω.definition: Desiderat. of wish to be a general, Pherecr.250, X.An.7.1.33, D.19.295, Plu.Eum.14; wish to make war, Str.4.6.7; to be going to war, Id.7.4.3

στρατηλατέω.definition: lead an army into the field; c. gen., to be commander of, command, Id.HF61, Rh.276: c. dat., Id.Ba.52, El.321,917

στρατηλάτης.definition: leader of an army, general, commander, Pratin.Lyr.1.9, S.Aj.1223, E.Ph.1241, and in late Prose, OGI648 , PLips.48.23 , etc.; = magister militum, Zos.2.33, Gloss., POxy.1983.2 , etc.; E.Or.970 ; also of an admiral, A.E…

στρατηλάτις.definition: fem. of voc. addressed to the Moon, PMag.Par.1.2275

στρατίαρχος.definition: = X.Lac.13.4, Supp.Epigr.7.12.7 ; = praefectus, D.C.42.4, al.: also Id.55.28, al

στρατιωτάριον.definition: sack or chest of military stores, POxy.1657

στρατοκῆρυξ.definition: herald of a camp or army, LXX3; one of 5 attached to a or Arr.Tact.10.4, Ael.Tact.9.4, Ascl.Tact.2.9; or to a Arr.Tact.14.4, Ael.Tact.16.2, Ascl.Tact.6.3

στρατολογέω.definition: ) levy an army, enlist soldiers, D.H.11.24, J.AJ5.1.28, al.:—Pass., D.S.12.67, cf. Plu.Caes.35

στρατολογία.definition: raising, levying an army, D.H.6.44, Hermog.Prog.10, PLips.54.10,13

Στρατονικίς.definition: epith. of Aphrodite at Smyrna, SIG990 , OGI229.12

στρατοπεδάρχης.definition: military commander, BGU1822.13 , D.H.10.36, J.BJ6.4.3, Mitteis Chr.87.5 , Procl.Par. Ptol.245; = praefectus castrorum, CIL 3.13648, 141875 , Luc.Hist.Conscr.22, Gloss

στρατοπεδεία.definition: encampment, X.HG4.1.24, Aen.Tact.16.15, LXXJo.4.3, Plb.1.48.10, al., D.H.10.23, Ael.Tact.3.3

στρατοπέδευσις.definition: encamping, X.Cyr.8.5.6; encampment, position of an army, X.HG4.1.25

στρατοπεδεύω.definition: encamp, bivouac, take up a position, X.An.7.6.24 , LXXGe.12.9, al.: more freq. in Med., Hdt.1.62,76, 2.141, Th.1.30, X.An.2.2.15, etc.; of a fleet, to be stationed, Hdt.7.124

στρατόπεδον.definition: camp, encampment, Id.5.63, A.Th.79; at Rome, the Castra Praetoriana, D.C.60.1, al

στρεβλοκάρδιος.definition: perverse or froward of heart, Aq., Sm., Thd. Pr.11.20

στρεβλόω.definition: fut. Plu.Phoc.35: aor; twist or wrench a dislocated limb, with a view to setting it, Hdt.3.129; also of wrestlers, Philostr.Im.2.6, cf. 1.6 :—Med., Alciphr.3.43:—Pass., acquire a squint, Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.78; ibid

στρέβλωσις.definition: putting to the torture, J.AJ19.1.5, Plu.2.1070b

στρεβλωτήριος.definition: racking, torturing, Hsch. s.v. rack, LXX4 Ma.8.13

στρεπτόλυτον.definition: a grammatical figure, in which the clauses are as it were intertwined, Sch.Aristid. ap.Phot.Bibl.p.401 B

στρεύγω.definition: distress, pain, Hsch.; but in Ep. used in Pass., to be exhausted or worn out, weary oneself, Il.15.512, cf. A.R.4.1058; Od.12.351; Tim.Pers.93; A.R.4.384; Call.Cer.68: abs., to be distressed, suffer distress or pain, …

στρεψίμαλλος.definition: with tangled fleece: metaph. of Euripides, in reference to his complex phrases, Ar.Fr.638

στρεψοδικέω.definition: twist or pervert the right, Ar.Nu.434

στρεψοδικοπανουργία.definition: cunning in the perversion of justice, Id.Av.1468

στρηνιάω.definition: run riot, wax wanton, Antiph.82, Sophil.6, Diph.132, Lyc.Fr.1.2, Apoc.18.7,9, PMeyer 20.23 ;= gerrio, gestio, Gloss.; cf. Phryn.357

στροβέω.definition: A.Ch.1052, etc.: fut. Lyc.756: aor. Plu.Num.13:—Pass. and Med., v. infr.: pf. Lyc.172: :—twirl or whirl about, Ar.Nu.700, cf. Com Adesp.219; Ar.Eq.386, V.1528: metaph., . . A.Ch.1052 ; distract, distress, LXXJb.9.34, …

στροβίλινος.definition: of a pine-cone, Dsc.1.71, Gal.6.288; cf

στροβιλοειδής.definition: like a conical, Thphr.HP3.12.9, cf. Ruf.Anat.32; Str.17.1.10. Adv. Ruf.Oss.21

στρόβιλος.definition: spinning-top, Pl.R.436d, Plu.Lys.12; cyclone, whirlwind, Arist.Mu.395a7, Epicur.Ep.2p.47U., Men.536.4 ; Luc.Tox.19, cf. Aristid.1.164J., Poll.4.159

στρογγυλαίνω.definition: make round or globular, Hippiatr.104:—Pass., Placit.3.4.5

στρογγυλοδίνητος.definition: turned into a round shape, rounded, Archestr.Fr.4.11

στρογγυλοειδής.definition: of round form, Plu.2.1121c, cf. Dsc.3.54 . Adv. Alex.Aphr.Pr.1.107, Alex.Trall.2

στρογγυλοπρόσωπος.definition: round-faced, Arist.HA495a2, Phgn.807b33, PPetr.3p.4 , PCair.Zen.76.9 , PGrenf.1.25 .12 , etc

στρογγυλόω.definition: to be round, Al. 3 Ki.7.31; Pass. to be or become round, globular, Placit.3.4.2, Erot. s.v

στρογγύλωσις.definition: a rounding, Hp.Art.61; trench, LXX1 Ki.17.20 cod. A, cf. Aq., Sm., Thd. 1 Ki.26.5

στρούθειος.definition: of an ostrich, PMich.Zen.9r.2; = passerina caro, Gloss

στρουθίζω.definition: chirp like a twitter, Ar.Fr.947 =; cleanse with the herb PSI4.429.16 , Dsc.2.74, PHolm.15.2

στρουθοκάμηλος.definition: also ostrich, from its; = III, Ps.-Dsc.2.163

στρουθοκέφαλος.definition: with the head of a Plu.2.520c, Gal.19.454

στροφάλιγξ.definition: curve, bend, D.P.162,584, Q.S.8.236; orbit of a heavenly body, Arat.43, Orph.Fr.236; of the bowels, Androm. ap. Gal.14.34

στρόφαλος.definition: = A. 1 or 2a, used in magic, Marin.Procl.28

στροφεύς.definition: vertebra, Poll.2.130; socket in which the pivot of a door moved, Ar.Th.487, Fr.255, Hermipp.47.9 , Thphr.HP5.6.4, Kourouniotes , IG11.287 B 148 , Plb.7.16.5

στροφή.definition: twist, such as wrestlers make to elude their adversary, Pl.R.405c: metaph., slippery trick, dodge, Ar.Pl.1154, cf. Ec.1026, Ra.775; A.Supp.623

στρόφιον.definition: Dim. of band worn by women; headband worn by priests, etc., Philoch.141 B., IG5.1390.179 , Plu.Arat.53, Arr.Epict.3.21.16, SIG869.21 ; cf. III

στροφιοῦχος.definition: epith. of Hermes, wearing the cj. for in Orph.H.28.5

στρόφις.definition: slippery fellow, twister, Ar.Nu.450 , Poll.6.130; cf. B.II

στροφοδινέομαι.definition: Pass., wheel eddying round, of vultures wheeling round their nest, A.Ag.51 : cf

στροφόομαι.definition: Pass., have the colic, Dsc.1.30, Arr.Epict.4.9.4, Gal.6.462; prob. in Sor.2.29

στρωματεύς.definition: coverlet, bedspread, Antiph.38; in pl. patchwork, as title of literary Miscellanies, Gell.Praef.7; the of Plu. is cited by Eus.PE1.7

στρωμάτιον.definition: Dim. of mattress or cushion, PCair.Zen.60.9, 241.3 , al.: pl., bed- clothes, M.Ant.5.1, POxy.1645.9

στρωματίτης ἔρανος.definition: a picnic at which the guests found their own Cratin.445, cf. Hsch. s.v

στρωματόδεσμον.definition: a leathern or linen sack in which slaves had to tie up the bedclothes , Ar.Fr.253, Pherecr.185, X.An.5.4.13, Aeschin.2.99; Pl.Tht.175e; Arist.Mu.398a8: also Amips.38, Plu.Caes.49, cf. Phryn.379

στρωματοφύλαξ.definition: one who has the care of the bedding, tablecloths, etc., Plu.Alex.57

στρωτήρ.definition: rafter laid upon the bearing beam; mostly in pl., Ar.Fr.72; of a drunken man, Thphr.Vert.12, cf. IG22.1672.63, al., 42.102.179,235 , Ph.Bel.87.25, Plb.5.89.6, IG12.324.11 : generally, cross-beam, Hp.Art.7,78; expld. b…

στρωτηρίδιον.definition: Dim. of foreg., Hsch., Suid. s.v

στυγνάζω.definition: to have a gloomy, lowering look, Ev.Marc.10.22: abs., PMag.Leid.W.5.5, Steph.in Hp.2.514D.; of threatening weather, Ev.Matt.16.3

στυγνότης.definition: gloominess, sullenness, Alex.197, Plb.3.20.3; Plu.Mar.43; of the sky, Plb.4.21.1

στυγνόω.definition: v. sq. :—Pass., to be gloomy, AP9.573

στυλίς.definition: Dim. of I, IG12.313.95; mast to carry a flag at the stern, Eratosth.Cat.35, Plu.Pomp.24, cf. Poll.1.90

στυλίσκος.definition: Dim. of peg, Hp.Mochl.38; = II, Eust.1039.38

στυλίτης.definition: standing or dwelling on a pillar, Suid.: fem. Stud.Pont.3.134

στυλοβάτης.definition: Dor. base of a column, stylobate, Pl.Com.42, Delph.3.88 C2 , IG22.1668.40, 42.102.8, al. , Inscr.Délos 365.30 , HeroAut.16.1, Vitr. 3.4.2, 4.8.2

στυλοπινάκιον.definition: pillar with figures on it, AP3 tit

στυλόω.definition: prop or stay with pillars, Apollod.Poliorc.145.10 ; Inscr.Délos 445.22 : metaph., give stay to one's life , AP7.648

στυππειοπώλης.definition: dealer in oakum, Ar.Eq.129, Critias70D., IG22.1570.24, 1572.8

στυπτηρία.definition: Ion. , name of any of; in Egypt, the alum monopoly, POxy.2116

στυριόω.definition: dub. sens., perh. guarantee by promise of oath, . . Mitteis Chr.31 iv 18 : hence ib. vii 2

στύφω.definition: Hp.Int.14, etc.: aor. inf. Hsch.:—Pass; in dyeing, treat fabrics, etc., with a mordant, Lysis ap.Iamb.VP17.76; prepare it by a preliminary dyeing with woad, PHolm.21.42; fixes alkanet, ib.15.18

στωϊκεύομαι.definition: play the Stoic, Numen. ap. Eus.PE14.7

στωμύληθρος.definition: talkative, fluent, Aristaenet.1.1; as if from unless it be abstract for concrete, Com.Adesp.30D

στωμυλία.definition: wordiness, Ar.Ra.1069, Plb.9.20.6; persiflage, small talk, AP7.222 ; Stesimbr.4 J

στωμύλλω.definition: to be talkative, chatter, babble; more freq. in Med. Id.Th.1073, Ra.1071: fut. Id.Eq.1376: aor. Id.Ach.579, Th.461 : also in good sense, talk, chat, Id.Pax995

στωμύλος.definition: also Luc.Musc.Enc.10, Im.15: :—wordy, talkative, Ar.Ach.429, Pl.Erx.397d, Theoc.5.79, etc.; this nonsense, AP9.39 : in good sense, fluent, suave, of Menander, ib.187; = lepidus, Gloss.: c.inf., Luc.Im.15; Alciphr.3.65…

συάγρειος.definition: of the wild boar, PCair.Zen. 692.18 ; ib.311.15 , and without Lync. ap. Ath.9.402a; Dsc.2.76.8

συαγριόμορφος.definition: like a wild boar, prob. in Orph.A.979

σύαγρος.definition: name of a dog, S.Fr.154; = or wild boar or sow, wild swine, Antiph.42, Dionys.Trag.1.2, PRyl.238.3 , etc.; Gal.12.633; un-Attic acc. to Phryn.358

Συβαρίζω.definition: live like a Sybarite or voluptuary, Archyt. ap. Stob.4.1.138

Σύβαρις.definition: gen. D.S.8Fr.19, Ath.12.521a; as Appellat., luxury, voluptuousness, Philostr. l.c., cf. Plu.Crass.32

Συβαρίτης.definition: Sybarite, Hdt.5.44, Ar.V.1427: fem. ib.1438: as Adj., Sybaritic feastings, Id.Fr.216; Theoc.5.146

συβριάζω.definition: = Hsch.; expld. as put by metathesis for EM732.26; hence restd. for in Ar.Pax344

συβριασμός.definition: = Id.; hence restd. for in Phryn.Com.64

συβωτέω.definition: to be a swineherd, Att. for Moer.p.355 P

συγγαλακτοτροφέω.definition: bring up as a foster-child with one's own, PCair.Preis.31.79

συγγαληνιάω.definition: to be calm or smooth together with, Eust.1233.64

συγγελάω.definition: laugh with, join in laughter, E.Fr.362.22, Hegesand.6, LXXSi.30.10; Call.Epigr.23.8

συγγένεια.definition: ties of kindred, family connexion, family influence, Pl.R.491c, Smp.178c; of the relation between Athens and Thebes, Decr. ap. D.18.186

συγγενεύς.definition: = only in dat. pl., JHS22.358 , LXX1 Ma.10.89 cod. A, Ev.Marc.6.4, Ev.Luc.2.44

συγγεννάω.definition: assist in procreating, Arist.HA632a20 : metaph., assist in generating it, Pl.Tht.156e; create together with . . , of the Stoics, Plu.2.426b:— Pass., come into existence at the same time, Plb.6.10.4, Ph.2.346, Plu.2.57…

συγγεύομαι.definition: taste also, Sch.Ar.Pax1115: aor. inf. Act. = degunere, dub. in Gloss

συγγεωργέω.definition: to be a fellow-labourer. Is.9.18; trans., help to till, Eun.VSp.467 B., cf. PAmh.2.94.17 , etc.; PSI1.77.20

συγγηράσκω.definition: fut. E.Fr.1058: aor. Alciphr.2.3:—grow old together with, Hdt.3.134; A.Ch.908, cf. E. l.c., Isoc.1.7:—pres. Aret.CA1.5

συγγίγνομαι.definition: Ion. and later Gr. fut; associate, keep company with, hold converse with, Hdt.3.55, E.El.603, Ba.237, Ar.Nu.1317 , V.1468 , Th.2.12, etc.; Pl.R.330c; Id.Lg.672a; also Ar.Nu.252: abs., coexist, cohere, Emp.22.8

συγγιγνώσκω.definition: Ion. and later Gr. fut; come to agreement legally, Leg.Gort.5.46, cf. PGnom.169 ; of the parties to a treaty, SIG56.33

συγγνωμονέω.definition: later form for IV, Apollod.2.7.6, J.AJ11.5.3, PGnom.161 , S.E.M.1.126, etc

συγγομφόω.definition: fasten together with nails, IG22.463.77, D.S.14.72, Aret.SD1.6, Plu.Num.9: metaph., Id.Pyrrh.33

σύγγραμμα.definition: writing, written paper, Hdt.1.48; written form, regulation, ordinance, Pl.Plt.299d sq.; Id.Phdr.258d; clause of a law, Aeschin.3.127 ; not worth a note, Gal.15.909

συγγραμματεύω.definition: to be along with another, IG12.202.36, 203.2, POxy.1427.2

συγγραμματοφύλαξ.definition: keeper of books, Sch.Luc.Apol.2, Suid. s.v

συγγραφεύς.definition: one who collects and writes down; commissioners appointed to draw up measures, Th.8.67, IG12.22.3, al., Philoch.122, Isoc.7.58

συγγραφή.definition: writing or noting down, Hdt.1.93; that which is written, writing, book, esp. in prose: history, narrative, Th.1.97, cf. Arr.An.6.16.5, Paus.10.19.5, etc

συγγράφω.definition: write or note down, X.Cyr.8.4.16; describe, Id.3.103, cf. 6.14

συγγυμνασία.definition: common exercise; experience, training, Dsc.1.42, Sor.1.3, Marcellin.Puls.164

συγγυμναστής.definition: companion in bodily exercises, Pl.Sph.218b, Lg.830b, Charito8.6, etc.; X.Lac.9.4

συγγυμνόομαι.definition: Pass., to be laid bare also, Gal.18.119

συγκαθαγίζω.definition: burn up together, Plu.Aem.24; burn along; metaph., help to sanctify, Phld.Herc.1232p.70V

συγκαθαιρέω.definition: Ion. put down together, join; take down with others, with their help took down her body, Plu.Agis20; help to take it off, opp. Pythag. ap. Porph.VP42, cf. D.L.8.17

συγκάθεδρος.definition: assessor, colleague, Ulp.adD.21.178, Hsch. s.v. condemned by Thom.Mag.p.292 R

συγκαθέζομαι.definition: sit down together, Pl.Tht.162d; crouch down, cower, Plu.2.970e

συγκαθείμαρμαι.definition: pf. Pass., to have been decided also by fate, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.292: in pres. sense, to be joined together by fate, Hierocl.p.54 A

συγκαθείργω.definition: Att. for shut up with others, X.Cyr.6.1.36, etc.:—Pass., to be shut up with, Aeschin.1.182; Luc.Cal.18: also in Pass., Plu.Sol.20, Cat.Mi.63

συγκαθέλκω.definition: drag down with or together, fut. Pass. A.Th.614

συγκαθεύδω.definition: fut. sleep with, A.Ch.906; esp. of sexual intercourse, Cratin.279, Ar.Ec.1009, Pl.Lg.838b

συγκαθέψω.definition: boil down with, Dsc.2.107:—Pass., Id.1.128, Eup.2.69

συγκαθιδρύω.definition: set up or dedicate with, Plu.2.44d, cf. IG7.271 3.50 , Jul.Or.4.150d:—Pass., POxy. 1256.14 ; IG5.497.17 , cf. Str.9.2.29

συγκαθιερόω.definition: join in dedicating, Sardis 7.8.13 , Plu.Cam.8, CIG 3827q ; dedicate together, Ph.1.451, 2.240 , Plu.2.612d

συγκαθίημι.definition: fut. E.Hel.1068:—let down with or; settle down, crouch, squat, Arist.Pr.869b11, D.S.20.51; Arist.HA539b29

συγκαθίστημι.definition: join in bringing back; join in setting up or establishing, esp. of setting up kings, A.Pr.307; Isoc.4.125, cf. Lex ap.And.1.97, Th.8.68, Pl.R.567b, X.Ages.2.31; help to set in order, Th.4.107

συγκαθοράω.definition: see at once or together, Gal.11.553

συγκαθορμίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be at anchor along with one, Plb.5.95.3

συγκαθοσιόω.definition: consecrate together with, in Pass., J.AJ16.2.4, Plu.2.636e

συγκακουργέω.definition: to be party with another in injuring, D.H.1.78, cf. 6.41, BGU15 ii 11 : abs., join in the injury, Arg.D.32

συγκαλινδέομαι.definition: Pass., roll about with, c. dat., Placit.4.19.3, v.l. for in X.Smp.8.32

συγκάμνω.definition: labour or suffer with, sympathize with; work with, S.El.987, PSI9.1075.6 ; E.Rh.396; . . Id.HF1386; Paus.8.14.9: abs., S.Aj.988; with the spear, E.Rh.326

συγκαμπή.definition: bight, joint, of the elbow joints, Hp.Nat.Hom.11 ; X.Eq.1.8; of the fingers, Arist.HA513a3; Poll.2.234

συγκάμπτω.definition: bend, Hp.Art.14, Pl.Phd.60b; IG42.121.28 ; of legs, arms, spine, etc., Diocl.Fr.141; LXXPs.68.24: intr., bend down, ib.4 Ki.4.35:— Pass., opp. X.Eq.12.5; of a person mounting a horse, ib.7.2; with the fingers doubled …

σύγκαμψις.definition: a bending together, Hp.Off.15; at the bend of the arm, Id.Fract.3; Arist.IA711b2; Id.Pr.870b1; Poll.2.234

συγκανηφορέω.definition: help as v.l. in Scol.22, as cited by Eust.1574.20

συγκαρκινόομαι.definition: Pass., entwine or interlace its roots, of wheat, Pherecr.20, cf. Poll.7.150

συγκαταβαίνω.definition: fut. aor. or come; go down together, opp. Arist.Mete.358b32; esp. to the sea-side, Th.6.30; Plb.1.39.12; Plu.Crass.31: metaph., Arist.Pol.1334b34, cf. 1335a31

συγκαταβάλλω.definition: throw down along with; lay as a foundation, metaph. in Pass., of the solid parts of the foetus, Gal.6.4

συγκατάβασις.definition: condescension to the level of an audience, Phld.Rh.2.25 s1.; also of the gods, esp. Attis, Jul.Or.5.171b

συγκαταβιβάζω.definition: decoy or draw into action, Plb.5.70.8; transfer accent to final syllable, A.D.Adv.173.11

συγκαταβιόω.definition: live with or together, Plu.2.754a, cf. Alciphr.1.32; Plu.2.500f

συγκαταγαπάω.definition: put up, be content with, Phld.Rh.1.135 S

συγκαταγηράσκω.definition: pf. Epicur.Fr.217:—grow old with or together, Is.2.7, Epicur. l.c., LXXTo.8.7; lasts to the end of it, Men.Kith.Fr.1; of fast colours, Hdt.1.203; of a morbid growth, Arist.GA776a5: abs., Hp.Carn.12, cf. Mul.2.116

συγκαταγιγνώσκω.definition: later condemn along with or at once, Aristid.1.495 J.:—Pass., App.BC1.62

συγκαταγράφω.definition: inscribe together, f.l. in; join in executing a conveyance, PLond.2.251.20

συγκατάγω.definition: bring down along with or together; join in bringing back, Ar.Th.339, cf. Isoc.16.13; ; Aeschin.2.78; from exile, Pl.Ep.333e

συγκαταδαρθάνω.definition: in aor. 2 as aor. of sleep with one, Ar.Ec.613,622

συγκαταδουλόω.definition: join in enslaving, ib.46. cf. Aristid.1.411 J.:—Med., Th.3.64, Hyp.Fr.272

συγκατάδυσις.definition: a setting together, Hipparch.1.1.10, al., Str.1.1.21 , Ptol.Alm.8.4

συγκαταζεύγνυμι.definition: yoke together, join in marriage, Plu.Cam.2, cf. Sor.1.34:—Pass., has become a yoke-fellow with misery, S.Aj.123; cf

συγκατάθεσις.definition: approval, assent, Plb.2.58.11; in Stoic philos., assent given by the mind to its perceptions, Zeno Stoic.1.39, al., cf. Plot.1.8.14, etc.; a term introduced into Latin by Cicero, Plu.Cic.40: cf

συγκαταθέω.definition: make an inroad with another, X.Cyr.5.3.1

συγκαταθλάω.definition: break all to pieces, Macho ap.Ath.8.348f

συγκαταθνῄσκω.definition: poet. aor. die along with, Mosch.3.65, AP7.139

συγκαταινέω.definition: agree with, favour, X.Cyr.3.3.20; c. acc. rei, sanction, approve, Hp.Praec.1, Plb.24.11.6: abs., Id.15.8.9, Plu.Cam.6

συγκάταινος.definition: agreeing with, assenting, Philipp. ap. D.18.167, cf. PTeb.22.5 , D.S.15.92; J.AJ4.8.23

συγκαταίρω.definition: come to land together, Plu.Crass.20, Lib.Or.61.4: metaph., Them.Or.3.42b

συγκαταιτιάομαι.definition: in aor. 1 as Pass., to be jointly accused, J.AJ15.7.10

συγκατακαίω.definition: Att. burn along with a thing, X.An.3.2.27, cf. IG12.526a.13 , AP11.133 :—Pass., to be burnt with, Hdt.4.69, D.S.2.28, 19.33

συγκατακαλύπτω.definition: wrap up with or in, Id.18.46

συγκατάκειμαι.definition: Pass., lie with, of sexual intercourse; recline with at meals, of a dog, Gal.18.291: abs., the guests, Plu.2.660a

συγκατακεράννυμι.definition: commingle, mix up with, Aesar. ap. Stob.1.49.27

συγκατακλείω.definition: Ion. shut in or enclose with or together, Hdt.1.182, Arist.HA557b4 , Alc.Com.23 ; Luc.DMort.14.4: metaph., Id.Vit. Auct.9:—Dor. aor. part. Chron.Lind. D62

συγκατακλίνω.definition: represent as lying with; make to lie with at table, ib.618e:—Pass., Ar.Ach.981

συγκατακοιμίζω.definition: cause to sleep with another, J.AJ12.4.6

συγκατακόπτω.definition: cut up or in pieces along with or together, Mnesith.Cyz. ap. Orib.4.4.1:—Pass., Plu.Sull.32, Caes.18, al

συγκατακόσμησις.definition: ordering or settling together, Phld.Mus.p.111 K

συγκατακρημνίζω.definition: throw down a precipice along with or together, J.BJ4.1.9 , cf. Ph.1.408

συγκατακτάομαι.definition: join with another in acquiring; acquire at the same time, Str.6.4.2

συγκατακτείνω.definition: slay together, aor. 2 part., . . S.Aj.230 ; but E.Or.1089

συγκατακυλίνδομαι.definition: Pass., pf. to be rolled down together with, D.H.Comp.20

συγκαταλαγχάνω.definition: occupy, have assigned in common, Dam.Pr.58

συγκαταλαμβάνω.definition: seize, take possession of together; comprehend together with, D.L.9.97

συγκαταλείπω.definition: leave together, leave a joint garrison in a place, Th.5.75

συγκαταλέχω.definition: lay down with, in aor. 1 Act., Epigr. in Philol.88.139 :—Med., lie down with, in non-thematic aor., Luc.Charid.4

συγκαταμείγνυμι.definition: mix in with, mingle, blend with, E.HF674 ; X.Hier.6.2:— Pass., to be absorbed into . . , Pl.Plt.288e; Arist.Mete.357b7

συγκαταμύω.definition: to be quite closed up, AP9.311

συγκαταναυμαχέω.definition: assist in conquering by sea, . . Aeschin.2.78, cf. D.S.5.52

συγκατανέμω.definition: count among, Longin. ap; Med., divide jointly among themselves, Th.6.4, cf. Str.10.3.4

συγκατανευσιφάγος.definition: living by saying 'yes', Comic epith. of Crates Theb.11 D

συγκατανεύω.definition: agree, consent to, Plb.3.52.6, etc.; agreed with him at every point, Id.7.4.9, cf. 30.1.9: abs., AP5.286.8

συγκαταπαίζω.definition: jest on a thing at the same time, Eust.1653.26

συγκαταπαύω.definition: bring at the same time to an end, Id.1393.57:—Pass., Olymp.in Mete.34.6

συγκαταπέμπω.definition: send along with, c. dat., Jul.Or.4.153b:—Pass., J.AJ18.1.1

συγκαταπίμπρημι.definition: burn together with, Ael.NA7.40:—Pass. aor. Paus.2.35.4, D.C.44.50, to be burnt with or together, Ph.2.21, Paus., D.C. ll.cc

συγκαταπίνω.definition: swallow together with, Gal.6.695:—Pass., to be swallowed together, Ph.1.311, 2.178 , Gal.Nat.Fac.3.8

συγκαταπίπτω.definition: fall down along with, let one's spirits fall with one's fortunes, D.H.Isoc.9; become despondent too, Onos.13.2; fall together in battle, J.AJ7.7.1; in wrestling, Gal.Nat.Fac.3.3

συγκαταπλέκω.definition: intertwine or intermix with, Arist.HA612b23; D.H.Pomp.1, cf. Plu.Sol.3:—Pass., Id.2.648b, Ph.2.151 , Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.98, Philum. ap. Orib.45.29.31

συγκαταπλέω.definition: sail into port with, of a pilot, PHib.1.38.4 ; sail down the Nile with, PCair.Zen.299.4 , PMich.Zen.46.9

συγκαταπολεμέω.definition: join in subduing, D.S.16.22; Id.19.15, cf. Str.13.4.2, J.AJ13.5.11

συγκαταποντόω.definition: sink in the sea together, S.E.M.5.92

συγκαταπράσσω.definition: Att. join in accomplishing or acquiring, D.5.23. D.C.59.10:—Med., D.8.27

συγκαταριθμέω.definition: reckon in, include, Phld.Lib.p.47 O., BGU1208.34 ; Ael.VH2.41, Str.4.1.8, Gal.6.728, etc.:—Med., reckon in, take into account, Arist.Cat.11a22:—Pass., to be included in, Demetr.Lac.Herc.1012.43, Ph.1.83, Plu.2.120b Ga…

συγκαταρράπτω.definition: sew in with, in Pass., prob. in Cyran.27

συγκαταρρέω.definition: fut. flow down or fall off together, Onos.4.4, v.l. in Dsc.5.88

συγκατασβέννυμι.definition: help to extinguish, Plu.2.648b:— Pass., to be extinguished with, c. dat., ib.973d

συγκατασκάπτω.definition: demolish with another or altogether, E.Or.735 , Ph.884, Rh.391, And.1.101

συγκατασκεδάννυμι.definition: pour over at the same time, in Med., X.An.7.3.32, with vv.ll

συγκατασκευάζω.definition: help in establishing or organizing, Th.1.93, cf. X.Lac.8.3; Pl.Plt.274d, cf. Isoc.3.6, etc.; Pl.Lg.920e; X.Vect.4.38; join in promoting it, D.18.143; assist him in promoting, Id.3.17: abs., Id.17.15:—Med., BCH55.43 :—…

συγκατασκηνόω.definition: establish in the same quarters, X.Cyr.5.4.17

συγκατασπείρω.definition: sow or plant together, Gal.19.168, Eun.Hist.p.251 D.:—Pass., Hld.3.12

συγκαταστασιάζω.definition: help in ruining by faction, Plu.Phil.13, 15

συγκατάστασις.definition: a falling in with so as to fight, Plb.4.12.8; pl., Id.38.11.5; a conflict with animals, Id.4.8.9

συγκαταστρέφω.definition: bring to an end together; Med., help to conquer, Th.6.69, Isoc.5.126, IG22.127.44 , Jul.Ep.9; X.Cyr.8.1.8

συγκατασύρομαι.definition: to be dragged down with, Ph.Fr.101 H

συγκατασχηματίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be in conformity with, Plu.2.442d, cf. Ptol.Tetr.63

συγκατασχίζω.definition: divide at the same place as, of a vein, Gal.15.532

συγκατατάσσω.definition: Att. arrange or draw up together, X.Cyr.6.3.32: metaph., Polyaen.5.2.22; take into account, . . Ph.1.692; classify with, Paul.Aeg.2.11:—Pass., range oneself beside, IG22.237.12 : metaph., to be arranged harmoniously, …

συγκατατήκομαι.definition: Pass., melt away together with, pine away over, M.Ant.5.1

συγκατατίθημι.definition: deposit together or at the same time; Med., put down the same vote or opinion with another, agree entirely with him, Pl.Grg.501c: with dat. only, agree with, assent or conform to, Epicur.Sent. Vat.29; Philipp. ap. D.1…

συγκατατρέχω.definition: to be in motion together with, Leucipp. ap. D.L.9.31

συγκατατρώγω.definition: aor. eat at the same time, Id.Sol.20, prob. f.l. for

συγκαταφέρω.definition: carry down with other things, Id.2.994d: —Pass., to be carried down together, Arist.Pr.931b21, Mete.357a17, LXXIs.30.30, Hld.8.16; sink down with . . , D.S.16.12; of arteries, etc., take the same course as, c. dat., G…

συγκαταφεύγω.definition: flee to for safety together, Ath.13.593b; D.C.38.33

συγκαταφλέγω.definition: burn with or together, Ph.2.527; Luc.Luct.14:—Pass., Plu.2.499c, cf. SIG 768.14 , Ph.2.27, Luc.Nigr.30; Polyaen.7.24

συγκαταφονεύω.definition: put to death with or together, Id.8.69

συγκατάφυρτος.definition: mixed or kneaded in together, Philox.3.17

συγκαταχωρίζω.definition: treat as identical, opp; deposit or register a deed together with others, BGU578.19 , etc

συγκαταψεύδομαι.definition: join in a lie against. Aeschin.2.158

συγκαταψηφίζομαι.definition: condemn with or together; Pass., to be reckoned along with, Act.Ap.1.26

συγκαταψύχω.definition: make cool, Gal.1.674:—aor. inf. Pass. PHolm.23.40

συγκάτειμι.definition: go down with, Luc.DMort.27.7; of hair on the side of the face, Philostr.Im.1.10: abs., descend together, Arist.Pr.907b11

συγκατεργάζομαι.definition: help or assist any one in achieving; help to conquer a country, Plu.Pyrrh.18

συγκατέρχομαι.definition: sink downwards together; come back, return from exile together, Lys.31.9, Arist.Pol.1300a18, etc.; with one, Lys.31.13; Plu.Dio29

συγκατεσθίω.definition: fut. Ath.9.386e; also LXXIs.9.18: pf. Plu.2.94a: aor. Jul.Mis.338c:—eat up, devour with or together, Plu.l.c., Thes.22, Mnesith. ap.Ath.8.357e, etc.; Jul. l.c

συγκατεύχομαι.definition: join in praying for, S.Ant.1336; pray to together with another deity, Plu.2.492c

συγκατέχω.definition: keep together with, Pl.Cra.404a; help in seizing, Lib.Decl.22.33; help in holding down, Tab.Defix.Aud.156.44

συγκατηγορέω.definition: join in accusing; in Logic, predicate jointly, A.D.Synt.201.5

συγκατήγορος.definition: joint accuser, counsel for the prosecution, Hyp.Eux.13

συγκατοικέω.definition: dwell with one, Plu.Per.20: metaph., S.OC1259

συγκατοικίζω.definition: colonize jointly, join in colonizing; settle or plant in a place along with, E.Hipp.646

συγκατοικτίζομαι.definition: Med., fut. lament with or together, S.Tr.535

συγκατορθόω.definition: help in righting, Isoc.5.151; Str.13.2.3, cf. D.H.6.86

συγκατορύσσω.definition: Att. bury with, Plu.Lys.30, cf.Luc.Luct.14; Plu.2.1113e:— Pass., Satyr.3

συγκαχρύω.definition: aor. inf. prob. cj. in Hsch. for and in Phot. for

σύγκειμαι.definition: Pass., lie together; as Pass. of to be composed or compounded, Pl.Phd.98c; Id.Tht.201e, cf. X.Cyn.5.29; Isoc.15.180; X.Oec.8.3; Pl.R.398d, cf. Phd.92a; Arist.Pol.1266a1; of quack-doctors, Hp.Lex1; Aeschin.3.229; Plu.S…

συγκελεύω.definition: join in ordering, bidding, E.IA892 , Th.8.31

συγκενόω.definition: empty out together, Ruf.Fr.80.5 , Gal.4.712, Porph.in Ptol.183, Alex.Trall.1.17

συγκεντέω.definition: pierce together, stab at once, Hdt.3.77, Plb.4.22.11, LXX2 Ma.12.23:—Pass., Hdt.6.29; cf

συγκεντρογραφέω.definition: dub. sens. in aor. Pass., Cat. Cod.Astr.8.174

συγκεράννυμι.definition: mix together, commingle, Pl.Cra.424e; AP12.168 ; Anacreont.20.4; make a mixture of both, Pl.R.397c

συγκεραυνόω.definition: strike with or as with a thunderbolt, Cratin.187, E.Ba.1103, LXX2 Ma.1.16:—Pass., thunder-stricken, Archil.77

συγκεφαλαίωμα.definition: sum total, Nicom.Ar.1.16, Iamb.in Nic.p.64 P

συγκεφαλαίωσις.definition: summing up, summary, Pl.Def.415b, Plb.9.32.6; Phld.Rh.1.79 S.; S.E.M.7.224; sum of numbers, Nicom.Ar.1.8, cf. Gal.18.652; entry in a register, PLond.2.259.56 , etc

συγκηδεύω.definition: join in burying, Phylarch.26 J.; bury along with, J.AJ7.15.3, cf. Suid. s.v. metaph., Plu.2.114e

συγκινδυνεύω.definition: incur danger along with others, Th.8.22, Plu.Art.8, etc.; by saying, Pl.Lg.969a; Plb.2.3.5: abs., share in the danger, be partners in danger, X.Ages.11.13, Pl.Phlb.29a, D.15.19, etc.; OGI 765.21 : c. dat. modi, with t…

συγκίρνημι.definition: = Ath.2.38f:—Pass., Ti.Locr.96a, Iamb.Comm.Math.10; also Tz. ad Lyc.p.2 S.:—Med., Ath.11.476a, D.L.7.158:—Pass., Porph.Sent.4, Sch.S.OC159

συγκλεισμός.definition: a being shut up, confinement; conclusion, POxy.275.20 ; PFlor.50.114

συγκλείω.definition: fut. Ion. fut old Att. fut. Ep. aor. Nonn.D.48.309:-Pass., aor. old Att. pf. Isoc.15.68, but Men.670, D.S.15.63, v.l. in E.Hec.487; old Att. Ion. :-shut or coop up, hem in, enclose, Hdt.4.157, 7.41; Th.8.67; Arist.HA5…

σύγκληρος.definition: having lots or portions that join; joined by lot to, allotted to, Plu.2.103f, cf. Luc.Am.24: c. gen., belonging to as portion, Lyc.995

συγκληρόω.definition: Dor. IG12.3.10 (Rhodes, i; choose by lot, v.l. in Plu.Alc.19

συγκλώθω.definition: connect by spinning, M.Ant.10.5, Dam.Pr.251:—Pass., to be interwoven, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.265, Plot.2.3.15; c. inf., Sch.Pi.O.1.38

συγκνισόομαι.definition: Pass., to be stewed together with, Ath.9.395f

συγκοιμάομαι.definition: Pass., sleep with, lie with, of the man; metaph., of an historian, Plb.12.26D.3; D.C.60.28

συγκοίμημα.definition: partner of one's bed, in pl., E.Andr.1273

συγκοίμησις.definition: a sleeping together, lying with, Pl.R.460b, cf. Phdr.255e; D.C.79.13

συγκοινόομαι.definition: Med., communicate, impart; in Pass., to be fastened firmly to, c. dat., HeroAut.13.9:—Pass. also, let in, sunk, Id.Bel.76.6

συγκοινωνέω.definition: have a joint share of; in NTc. dat., take part in, have fellowship with, Apoc.18.4; Ep.Eph.5.11; Ep.Phil.4.14

συγκοιτάζω.definition: make to lie with, Tz.H.2.773:—Pass., lie with, Id. ad Lyc.848, Aq.De.28.30, Cyran.63

συγκολάζω.definition: help in chastising, Pl.Lg.730d; chastise as well, . . J.AJ2.6.8, cf. Ph.2.326

συγκολλάω.definition: glue or cement together, IG22.1668.82 , Luc.Alex.14: metaph., Pl.Mx.236b, Ar.V.1041 ; Pl.Ti.43a:—Pass., unite, of a wound, Sor.1.36

συγκολλήσιμος.definition: glued together, PGrenf.2.41.18 ; POxy.2131.4 : Subst. ib.34 i 13 , etc

συγκόλλησις.definition: gluing together, Clearch.44; adhesion, Sor.1.43: metaph., attachment, Them.Or.22.268a

συγκολλητής.definition: one who glues together, fabricator, Ar.Nu.446

συμμελαίνομαι.definition: Pass., become quite black, Plu.2.587c; become black together with, Phleg.Fr.36.34 J

συμμελετάω.definition: exercise or practise with or together, Antipho3.4.6, AP12.206

συμμένω.definition: hold together, keep together; of treaties or agreements, hold, stand fast, continue, Hdt.1.74; Th.1.18; Id.8.73; Pl.Phdr.232b, cf. Arist.EN1133a12; . . ib.1132b34: cf. I.5

συμμεριτεύω.definition: share with, c. dat., BGU 993 iii 2

συμμεσουράνημα.definition: culmination of a star, as the sun is rising, as the sun is setting, Ptol.Alm.8.4

συμμεταβαίνω.definition: pass over together, J.AJ15.6.6, S.E.M.10.26, Luc.Nigr.38: c. dat., A.D.Synt.236.4

συμμεταβάλλω.definition: change along with; intr. in Act., change with or together, Arist.GA716b4, MA702b23, EN1100a28, Str.10.2.12, Ph.1.276

συμμεταλαμβάνω.definition: partake in a thing with another, J.AJ5.9.1: c. gen., M.Ant.9.41; A.D.Adv.162.7

συμμεταλλάσσω.definition: change at the same time, Tim.Gaz. ap. Ar.Byz.Epit.89.16, cf. Phld.D.1.24

συμμεταποιέω.definition: alter along with or together, Philum.Ven.4.8

συμμετατίθημι.definition: transfer at the same time, in Med., shift one's shield at the same time to meet the blow, Plb.18.30.7:—Pass., change along with, Id.9.23.4, cf. A.D.Synt.239.9: abs., ib.162.19

συμμετεωρίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be raised together with; of the breathing, become shallow at the same time, Hp.Epid.6.7.1

συμμετεωροπολέω.definition: walk on air together with, Philostr.VA6.11

συμμετοικίζομαι.definition: Pass., migrate, change abodes together with, Ael.NA12.35; . . Eust.77.4

συμμέτοχος.definition: partaking with another in a thing, J.BJ1.24.6, cf. Ep.Eph.5.7: as Subst., joint owner, PLond.5.1733.52

συμμέτριος.definition: of the same class or standard, PMasp.310.10 , PLond.5.1711.28

συμπεριθέω.definition: revolve with, M.Ant.7.47, Jul.Or.4.150b; run about with, Luc.Merc. Cond.24; App.BC4.18

συμπεριίσταμαι.definition: Pass., close in, draw together, Thphr.HP5.5.2

συμπεριπλέω.definition: sail about with, c. dat., App.BC5.96, Ps.-Hdt.Vit.Hom.8

συμπεριποιέω.definition: help in procuring, Plb.3.49.9, cf. D.S.11.81

συμπεριπολέω.definition: go round together with, Phld. D.3.9; Cat.Cod.Astr.1.136; accompany, Ph.1.16 , Plu.2.745e, etc.:—hence Procl.in Alc.p.138C., Herm.in Phdr.p.92A., Dam.Pr.370

συμπερισπάω.definition: to circumflex also, A.D.Adv.170.10:— Pass., c. dat., Id.Synt.335.18, EM171.39

συμπεριστρέφομαι.definition: Pass., revolve along with, of the fixed stars, Arist.Mu.392a10, cf. Gem.5.62; Plu.2.927c; of pain in colic, Gal.8.384

συμπεριτίθημι.definition: put round together, take part in getting honour for another, Id.Nic.5:—Pass., Dsc.1.57:—the Act. is dub. l. in Nech. ap. Vett. Val.290.21

συμπεριτρέπω.definition: overthrow together with, S.E.P.2.188, cf. 193 :—Pass. also, of leaves of heliotrope, Dsc.4.190

συμπεριτρίβομαι.definition: to be rubbed up together, Gal.13.1041

συμπεριτυγχάνω.definition: fall in with at the same time, v.l. in X.An.7.8.22

συμπεριφαντάζομαι.definition: Med., form conceptions of also, M.Ant.10.38

συμπεριφέρω.definition: carry round along with or together; Pass., to be carried round together, Pl.R.617b; Id.Phdr.248a; Epicur.Ep.2p.53U.; with . ., Placit.2.13.9; Stoic.2.195, cf. Theo Sm.p.134 H.; Dsc.4.164, cf. 190 ; HeroDef.135.10

συμπεριφθείρομαι.definition: Pass., go about with any one to one's own ruin, Luc.Pseudol.18, Ath.7.289c; cf. II

συμπεριφορά.definition: intercourse, companionship, society; accommodating temper, indulgence, complaisance, UPZ110.44 , Plb.1.72.2, 23.2.10, Plu.2.124b, POxy.1590.5 ; Epicur. Oxy.215 ii7; Phld.Piet.115; OGI308.17 ; Jul.Or.6.200c; to be indu…

συμπεριφράσσω.definition: fence all round or together, Arist.Phgn.811a8

συμπερονάω.definition: pin together, Plu.Crass.25, cf. Apollod.Poliorc.168.6, Them.Or.21.253a

συμπέσσω.definition: Att. mature by heating, cooking, Arist.Mete.381a20, cf. HA625a6, Thphr.HP8.7.7; concoct, bring to a head, etc., Dsc.2.86, Gal.6.247, 825, 15.889; hatch eggs, Arist.HA549b7, cf. 560b17 , GA752b17; ib.753a19, cf. 752b33…

συμπετάννυμι.definition: spread out with or together, Aen.Tact.37.9

συμπέτομαι.definition: fly with or together, Luc.Musc.Enc.6, Ael.NA2.48; Philostr.Im.2.2

συμπήσσω.definition: later form for Str.7.3.18 , Dsc.4.9, Gal.Thras.27

συμπιέζω.definition: press or squeeze together, grasp closely, Pl.Phd.89b; Id.Sph.247c; Ephipp.6.3, cf. Plu.2.58od ; AP5.127 ; Arist.Pr.929b39:—Pass., to be squeezed up, opp. X.Mem.3.10.7; Arist.Pr.904a21; ib.964b3; of the body, to be pin…

συμπιλέω.definition: force together like felt: generally, compress, Pl.Ti.45b:—more freq. in Pass., ib.49c, Plt.281a, Arist.Ph.216a31, HeroSpir.1 Prooem., etc.; . . Diocl.Fr.26; of felted texture, Thphr.HP3.7.5; was matted together, Pl.Ti…

συμπιπίσκω.definition: give to drink together, Schwyzer 323 D 48

συμπιπράσκω.definition: pf. PGen.23.8 :—sell with or together, in Pass., J.AJ12.4.4, App.BC4.24

συμπίπρημι.definition: set fire to or burn at the same time, J.BJ6.5.2: c. dat., Str.17.3.14:—Pass., Ph.2.565

συμπίπτω.definition: Ion. Iterat. Emp.59:—fall; generally, fall in with, meet with, esp. with accidents or misfortunes, c. dat. rei, Hdt.3.52; S.OT113; Id.Aj.429; but simply, fall in with, meet, UPZ62.10 , PTeb.58.56

συμπιστεύω.definition: believe or trust along with, J.BJ1.26.5

συμπλανάομαι.definition: wander about with, D.S.3.59, Plu.Ant.29, Philostr.Ep.56: metaph., . . Plb.3.21.10

συμπλαστεύω.definition: fashion, mould, or construct with, c. dat. et acc., PSI2.171.19

συμπλέκω.definition: 2 aor. Pass. and; combine notions logically under one term, Arist.de An.409b11, cf.EN1119b30; join words so as to form a proposition, Pl.Sph.262d, cf. Tht.202b:—Pass., Id.R.533c; of words, opp. , Arist.Ph.195b15, cf. …

συμπλέω.definition: sail in company with, Hdt.4.149, 5.46, E.IA102; Hdt.4.179; Th.6.44: abs., Id.1.27, Antipho5.20, prob. in IG12.99.10; Pl.Grg.511e; IG3.236: metaph., E.HF1225

συμπληθύω.definition: help to fill or increase, Hdt.4.48, cf. 50; multiply, Longin.23.3; D.C.52.42, 56.2

συμπλημμελέω.definition: sin together with, Aq., Sm., Thd., Quint.Ho. 4.15

συμπληρόω.definition: fill up or completely, man them fully, Th.6.50, cf. Hell.Oxy.14.1; Pl.Lg.770b; Arist.Mete.340a18, PA694b1, cf. Pl.Smp.202e, IG22.1668.71; Thphr.Od.45, Diocl.Fr.147; Plu.2.694b:—Med., Pl.Ti.35c, cf. 36b; Hell.Oxy.2.4:—…

συμπλήρωμα.definition: blocking or filling up of a body, Arist.Pr.901a4, Epicur.Ep.1p.11U

συμπλήρωσις.definition: completion, Plb.5.90.4; LXX2 Ch.36.21; filling up, Str.3.5.7; blocking of blood-vessels, Heliod. ap. Orib.47.14.4; aggregation of all . . , Longin.12.2

συμπνέω.definition: poet. Supp.Epigr.7.12.11 (Susa, i; abs., coalesce, achieve unity, Pl.Lg.708d, Arist.Pol.1303a26, Plu.Comp.Lyc.Num.4; D.18.168; Ael.NA3.44

συμποδίζω.definition: tie the feet together, bind hand and foot; metaph., entangle, enchain, Pl.R.488c :—Pass., Id.Grg.482e, cf. Tht.165e

συμποιέω.definition: help or assist in doing, And.1.62; compose jointly with, Eup.78 ; . . . . Ar.Fr.580, cf. Th.158; of a sculptor, Sch.Ar.Nu.857

συμποικίλλομαι.definition: Pass., to be wrought in with; vary with, Sch.Ptol.Tetr.19

συμποιμαίνω.definition: to be a shepherd with, J.AJ1.19.3 :—Pass., feed together, herd together, E.Alc.579

συμπολιορκέω.definition: join in besieging, besiege jointly, Hdt.1.161, IG12.108.40 , Th.8.15, D.23.131, IG22.666.14, etc. :—Pass., Th.3.20,68, Plb.2.7.8

συμπολίτης.definition: fellow-citizen, E.Heracl.826, J.AJ19.2.2, IG 14.1878 ; condemned by Phryn.150: fem. D.S.34/5.2.16, Eust.119.6

συμπολλαπλασιάζω.definition: multiply at the same time, Papp.24.19

συμπομπεύω.definition: accompany in a procession, Aeschin.1.43, Arist.Rh. Al.1423b3, 1424a5, Polyaen.1.23.2, Plu.Arat.53, Arr.Epict.4.1.104, IG4.679 , SIG577.76 , etc

συμπονέω.definition: toil or suffer with or together, with one, A.Pr.276; S.El.986, etc.; X.Cyr.7.5.55; Plu.Ant.43; E.Or.[1224]; take part in them, ib.683: abs., labour together, S.Ant.41, etc.; Ar.Ach.695 ; Arist.Pr.883a14, cf. Thphr.Sud.34

συμπονηρεύομαι.definition: join others in villainy, play the knave together with, Ar.Lys.404, cf. Isoc.15.224

συμπορεύομαι.definition: come, go, or proceed together, Th.8.87; assemble, of the Senate, Plb.6.16.4; of a workers' guild, SIG460.3 : metaph., consort together, hold intercourse, Plu.Lyc.15

συμπορθέω.definition: help to destroy or sack, E.Or.888, cf. BCH21.599 ; involved in like ruin, Str.8.3.29

συμπορθητής.definition: one who helps to destroy, Sch.Lyc.222

συμπορίζω.definition: help in procuring, Th.7.20; Jul.Or.3.125c :—Med., do so for oneself, Th.8.1, Isoc.4.32 :— Pass., to be got together, Plu.Mar.40

συμπορπάομαι.definition: Pass., to be fastened together, LXXEx.36.13, Anon. ap.Suid.s.v

συμπορσύνω.definition: help to arrange, promote, Hp.Art.16; A.R.4.549

συμποσία.definition: drinking together, Alc.46. Pi.P.4.294, LXX3 Ma.5.15, al

συμποσίαρχος.definition: president of a drinking-party, toastmaster, X.An.6.1.30, Alex.21, Plu.2.208b, 620f, OGI646.14 , etc.; also Supp.Epigr.7.151,168 . cf

συμπόσιον.definition: drinking-party, symposium; the party itself, the guests, LXX3 Ma.5.36, Plu.2.157d, 704d; . . in groups, Ev.Marc.6.39

συμποσόω.definition: reckon together, Heph.Astr.2.27, Eustr.in EN37.34, Tz.H.13.447

συμπραγματεύομαι.definition: aor. IG11.1055.10 , Lycon ap.D.L.5.71 :—assist in transacting business, Plu.Cat.Ma.21; Id.Lyc.5; IG22.844.17 , cf.PTeb.812.13 : abs., Plu.2.417a, CIG 1997d

συμπράσσω.definition: Att. Ion. :—join or; abs., lend aid, cooperate, . . S.Tr.1177, cf. Lys.12.85, etc.; the confederates, Th.4.67, 8.14, X.HG3.3.10

συμπραΰνομαι.definition: to be mitigated at the same time, of fever, Gal.18 .70

συμπρέπω.definition: befit, beseem, Pi.N.3.67, cf. Plu.Phil.11, Aristaenet.1.12

συμπρεσβεύω.definition: to be a fellow-ambassador, be joined or associated with on an embassy, D.19.189, Aeschin.2.169, IG22.844.15, OGI333.12 :—Med., join in sending an embassy, Th.3.92, 5.44

συμπροαύξομαι.definition: Pass., increase with or together, Hp.Epid.2.1.8

συμπρογιγνώσκω.definition: foreknow or foresee along with, Iamb.Myst.6.4

συμπρόεδρος.definition: joint-president, IG22.450.8 , al., Aeschin.2.85, Decr.Att. ap. J.AJ14.8.5, IG42.84.25

συμπρόειμι.definition: go forth along with or together, Arist.Mech.850b22, J.AJ12.9.4, Hdn.1.16.3, Ath.6.272e

συμπροέρχομαι.definition: = foreg., Satyr.3, OGI248.15 , J.Vit.56, Gal.2.558, Dam.Pr.74

συμπροθυμέομαι.definition: have equal desire with, share in; c. acc. rei, join zealously in promoting, Th.8.1, cf. X.Cyr.6.1.19

συμπροίημι.definition: in Med., join in paying, of a bank official, BGU 1748.4 , al

συμπροικίζω.definition: furnish with a dower together, gloss on Sch.D.18.268

συμπρομηθέομαι.definition: have providence over together with, Jul.Or.5.167b

συμπροπέμπω.definition: join in escorting, Hdt.9.1, Ar.Ra.404, 410, X.Cyr.1.6.1, etc.; Th.1.27; in funeral procession, D.H.8.59

συμπροπίπτω.definition: rush forth with, f.l. in Plb.31.14.1

συμπροπορεύομαι.definition: travel forward with, LXXDe.31.8 cod. A

συμπροσάγω.definition: bring along with or together, Aen.Tact.10.23 , Gal.7.617

συμπροσγίγνομαι.definition: Dor. help, assist; to be further added, of planetary combination, Ptol.Tetr.186, Vett.Val.60.28, al

συμπρόσειμι.definition: to be present together, LXXPs.93.20, Ec.8.15, PRev.Laws 27.18 , Nech. ap. Vett.Val.280.4

συμπροσμείγνυμι.definition: intr., to be in company with, Pl.Tht.183e

συμπροσπίπτω.definition: happen at the same time, Gal.1.124; occur to one at the same time, M.Ant.7.22

συμπροσπλέκομαι.definition: Pass., contend or struggle hard, Thd. Da.11.10

συμπροτίθημι.definition: cause to be placed first at the same time, A.D.Synt.128.20

συμπροτρέπω.definition: urge on or exhort at the same time, D.H.Rh.7.6

συμπροφαίνω.definition: bring forth to light together, Plot.5.8.4

συμπροφέρω.definition: pronounce at the same time, Sch.Pi.O.3.81; involve, Simp.in Ph.904.21

συμπροφητεύω.definition: prophesy along with or together, Plu.2.860d, cf. Him.Or.21.8

συμπτύσσω.definition: fold or pack together, S.Tr.691:-Pass., eyelids which close, Gal.UP10.6. 2. Pass., are folded together fan-wise, Procl.Hyp.5.115: metaph., to be implicit, not yet unfolded, Dam.Pr.1; ib.32, cf. Procl.Inst.171. 3. knoc…

σύμπτωμα.definition: anything that happens; mishap, mischance, Th.4.36, Arist.Pol.1304a1, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.339, IG7.411.4 ; D.56.43; . . Men.590; Id.817

σύμπτωσις.definition: falling together, collapsing; falling together, meeting, Plb.3.49.6; Id.2.14.8; point of meeting or intersection, Archim.Sph.Cyl.1.10, al., Str.2.1.10,37, Ptol.Geog.1.3.1, Dam.Pr.29

συμπυκνόω.definition: press close together, make compact, Hp.Oss.16, Thphr.CP5.4.2; Tz.H.5.332:—Pass., to be condensed, Hp.Oss.14

συμπυνθάνομαι.definition: inquire about with, E.Hel.328: simply, learn, Eun.Hist.p.259 D

συμπυρόω.definition: burn up, consume along with or together, E.Cyc.308, Rh.960:—Pass., Id.Supp.1071

συμπωλέω.definition: sell with or together, D.C.59.21; confirm the sale, IG12 .872.114 , SIG169.41 , PGrenf.1.25 ii 12

συμπωρόομαι.definition: Pass., solidify, of stones in the kidneys, Hp.Int.14:— later in Act., c. dat., Gal.13.536

συμφαίνομαι.definition: Pass., appear along with or together, Eun.VSp.460B

συμφαντάζομαι.definition: Pass., to be imagined along with; Med., entertain fancies along with, Porph.Gaur.5.4

σύμφημι.definition: fut. Pl.Prt.357b, al.: aor. 1; c. acc. rei, concede, agree to, grant, . . Id.Smp.177e, cf.Sph.247a, Prt.330d, X.An.5.8.8, etc.: hence abs., I grant you, Pl.R.403c,608b; freq. in Platonic dialogue, say yes or no, ib.52…

συμφθείρω.definition: destroy together or altogether, E.Andr.947; Pass., to be with a person to his or one's own hurt, whose partner in crime am I? Heraclit.Ep.7.3; having unfortunately met at one place, Plu.2.708e; of illegitimate sexual …

συμφθίνω.definition: decay along with, Arist.GA745a16, cf. Ael.NA12.13; of stones which wane along with the moon, Sch.Ptol.Tetr.3

συμφιλοδοξέω.definition: agree in promoting one’s honour, gloriae meae, Cic.Att.5.17.2; share one’s public spirit, Rev.Ét.Gr.19.115 , cf. BCH28.46 , Supp.Epigr.4.275, 281

συμφιλοκαλέω.definition: join in love of the beautiful, Plu.2.53c, Sert.14; with one, J.AJ Prooem.2; D.S.3.59

συμφιλολογέω.definition: join in literary studies, Cic.Fam.16.21.8, Iamb.in Nic.p.125 P

συμφιλομαθέω.definition: join in love of knowledge, Dion.Calliph.23

συμφιλονικέω.definition: take part with, side with; abs., join in a disputation, Plu.Arat.3: hence dub. in Phld.Rh.1.161 S

συμφιλοσοφέω.definition: join in the love and pursuit of wisdom, Arist.EN1172a5, Plu.Cic.24, Luc.D Mort.18.2, etc.; study Aristotle's philosophy with . . , Str.16.2.24, cf. Epicur.Fr.217

συμφιλοτιμέομαι.definition: join in zealous efforts, abs. or c. dat., D.S.2.18, Plu.2.813c, Luc.6, Supp.Epigr.4.319.2 , etc.; IG22.1225.6 , D.S.19.52:—also Act., Supp.Epigr.4.442

συμφλάω.definition: crush in pieces, Hp.Foet.Exsect.1, Epid.5.74, Mul.1.70, IG11.199 B 16, 203 B 46

συμφλεγμαίνω.definition: to be inflamed at the same time, Gal.10.909, 16.539, al., Aret.CA2.8

συμφλέγω.definition: burn up, burn to cinders, E.Ba.595 ; Theoc.22.211; LXXIs.42.25; with love, AP5.110 :—Pass., Plu.Alex.60

συμφλυαρέω.definition: chatter or trifle along with, M.Ant.9.41

συμφοιτάω.definition: Ion. go regularly to a place together, Hdt.2.60, 4.180; esp., go to school together, Ar.Eq.988 , Pl.Euthd.272d, D.39.24, Gal.6.756; with one, Luc.Ind.3; Pl.Euthd.304b, etc.; X.Smp.4.23; Aristid.Or.23.16

συμφοιτητής.definition: schoolfellow, Pl.Euthd.272c; fellow-pilgrim to the temple of Asclepius, Aristid.Or.50.42 , 48.27, 28.133

συμφορά.definition: mishap, misfortune, Hippon.49.4, etc.; early writers freq. add an epith., Hdt.1.41, 7.190; Pi.O.7.77; A.Pers.445; S.El.1179: c. gen., A.Pers.436; ib.1030 : but the word came to be used alone in a bad sense, Pi.P.8.87;…

συμφοράζω.definition: bewail, LXXIs.13.8, Orph.Fr.49.52, Sch.S.Ant.528; Phld.Mort.25, cf. CratesEp.26, Diog.Ep.39.1:—Med., Ps.Callisth.2.15

συμφόρημα.definition: that which is brought together, compound, Ph.1.184, Plu.2.955a; Ph.1.654

σύμφορος.definition: suitable, useful, profitable, c. dat., . . the sixth day is not good for a girl, Id.Op.783; . . Thgn.457; Id.526; . . Th.3.47; . . Pl.Lg.766e, Isoc.6.74 ; = S.OC592; . . Ar.Pl.1162, cf. Th.2.36: what is expedient, S.O…

συμφράσσω.definition: Att. fut. or pack; abs., of troops, close their ranks, form in close order, Id.4.64.7, 10.14.12, Plu.Ages.18:—Med., D.C.62.12

συμφροντίζω.definition: have a joint care for, Luc.Dem.Enc.25: abs., IG22.1329.18

συμφρύγω.definition: burn or parch quite up, Thphr.Ign.62; LXX4 Ma.3.11:—Pass., aor. ib.Jb.30.30, al

συμφυγαδεύω.definition: banish at the same time, Iamb.VP35.262, Phot

συμφυλάσσω.definition: keep guard along with others, Hdt.7.172; X.Mem.2.8.3, cf. Pl.R.451d; SIG742.10 , etc

συμφυλέτης.definition: of the same IG12.505.18 : generally, fellow-countryman, 1 Ep.Thess.2.14

σύμφυλος.definition: of the same stock or race with; metaph., of the same class with, . . Arist.Mu.394a19; cognaie, suitable, Plu.2.729c, 991b; ib.661e; of digested food, Gal.6.303; Plu.2.137b; Phld.Vit.p.28 J.; Orib.Fr.124; Dam.Pr.146

συμφυράω.definition: = Dsc.2.24 (v.l; mix up with, Plu.2.398a; Vett.Val.275.19

συμφυτεύω.definition: plant along with or together; metaph., helps him to achieve glory, Pi.I.6.12; to have had a hand in contriving, S.OT347:—Pass., to be implanted also, X.Mem.1.2.23

σύμφυτος.definition: born with one, congenital, innate; c. dat., natural to, Lys.10.28; Pl.Lg.844b; opp. , Arist.HA521b17, cf. Thphr.Sens.1,16

συμφύω.definition: later CR33.5 :—make to; Pass., with pf. Act. aor. 2 ; also Arist.Pol.1262b13, Thphr.CP5.5.3, Sor.1.36, etc.: fut. Gp.4.12.9:—grow together, Emp.26.7,95 , Pl.Smp.191a, Ti.76e, X.Cyr.4.3.18, etc.; Pl.Phdr.246d; of a pol…

συμφωνέω.definition: sound together, be in harmony or unison (cf; metaph., harmonize with, Pl.Sph.253b, cf. Phd.101d, Arist.EN1107a32; Pl.R.398c; Id.La.193e; in harmony with practical experience, Gal.19.217; Isoc.5.87; . . Epicur.Ep.1p.28…

συμφώνημα.definition: agreement, PFlor.379.7 , Sch.Th.7.33; watchword, token, Sch.E.Or.1130

συμφωνία.definition: concord or unison of sound; of two sounds only, musical concord, accord, such as the fourth, fifth, and octave, Pl.R.531a, 531c; Arist.Pr.921a13, cf. Hp.Vict.1.8; distd. from mere Arist.Pol.1263b35

σύμφωνος.definition: agreeing in sound, harmonious, Ar.Av.221; as musical term, in concord or unison with, Pl.Ti.80a, Lg.812d; Thphr.Fr.89.7; distd. from and Arist.Pr.918b30, 921a7; distd. from and , Ptol.Harm.1.7; = Pl.Phlb.56a

συμφωτίζομαι.definition: Med., give light together with, Placit.3.1.6:—Pass., Gal.18.72

συμψαύω.definition: touch one another, Hp.Off.11, Arist.HA562a27, Fr.208, Thphr.HP8.5.2, IG7.3073.107 ; X.Smp.4.26; Plb.6.29.3: c. gen., Str.11.8.8, Iamb.VP27.130

συμψάω.definition: rake together, Eup.113; . . PPetr.2p.110 ; obliterate the traces left by anything in sand, Ar.Nu.975 ; of a rapid river, sweep away, Hdt.1.189, cf. Iamb. ap. Suid. s1.v., Eus.Mynd.63; carry off, arrest a man, PTeb.13.…

συμψελλίζω.definition: stammer with or together, Arr.Epict.2.24.18, Max. Tyr.7.8

συμψεύδομαι.definition: Med., tell a lie together, Plb.6.3.10; with one, Plu.2.508e

συμψηφίζω.definition: reckon together, count up, Act.Ap.19.19; Med., vote with, Ar.Lys.142, cf. Poll.8.15:—Pass., App.BC3.22, Sammelb.7378.9 , v.l. in LXXJe.29.21

συμψηφολογέω.definition: apply mosaic to a surface, in Pass., HeroStereom.2.35

συναγάλλομαι.definition: rejoice with, c. dat., Historia 6.597 , Eustr.in EN106.22

συναγανακτέω.definition: to be vexed along with, Plb.4.7.3, Phld.Rh.2.140S., D.H.10.6, Str.4.4.2; Plb.2.59.5: abs., Men.543, D.S.19.61, Plu.Rom.7

συναγανάκτησις.definition: common anger or vexation, Arist.HA612b35, D.H.7.45

συναγγέλλω.definition: announce together, v.l. in D.H.10.26; simply, announce, Zos.4.55, 5.14

συναγελάζομαι.definition: Pass., herd together, Democr.164; of gregarious fish, Arist.HA610b1, cf. Frr.308,316,339; of men, Plb.6.5.7, cf. Plu.Cam.10; of sows, Id.2.917c: metaph., takes part with . . , ib.40a

συναγελασμός.definition: herding together, ib.980a, Gp.16.1.10; of men, Porph.Sent.32: in pl., forming of Plu.Comp. Lyc.Num.4

συναγοράζω.definition: pf. IG22.903.6:—buy up; frequent the marketplace with, Plu.2.796d

συναγορεύω.definition: c. dat. rei, D.15.15; Arist.Rh.Al.1424b16; ib.35; Isoc.5.3; agree or assent to, Id.4.139; Gal.16.516, cf. 589, al

συναγραυλέω.definition: live in the country along with, D.H.1.39

συναγρεύω.definition: join in the chase, AP9.337 :—Pass., Nonn.D.20.387

συναγριαίνω.definition: to be fierce along with, Them.Or.15.191c

συνάγχη.definition: a kind of sore throat, Demad. ap. Poll.7.104, Plu.Dem.25, Aret.CA1.7, Favorin. in PVat.11.5.39, etc.; cf

συναγωγή.definition: a bringing together; of persons, Pl.Tht.150a; collecting, etc., Plb.4.7.6, D.L.2.129, etc.; Ath.5.192b; assembling, meeting, IG12.91.9, cf. Test.Epict.4.7

συναγωνιάω.definition: share in anxiety, Plb.3.43.8, Plu.2.95e, etc.: c. dat., with one, Cic.Att.5.12.2, D.S.17.100; Plu.2.486b

συναγωνίζομαι.definition: generally, share in the fortunes of another, Th.3.64; aid, succour, D.21.190; one in a thing, Id.18.25, 30.31; one towards a thing, Id.18.20; D.H.4.4, Michel 452 : generally, assist, Metrod.Herc.831.19; D.48.43

συναγώνισμα.definition: succour in a contest: generally, succour, support, Plb.10.43.2

συναγωνιστής.definition: those who take part in contending for the prize, Michel 1016 ; OGI51.56 ; of a company of Dionysiac artists, CIG3082

συναδηλέομαι.definition: Pass., to be obscure together, S.E.M.8.2

συναδικέω.definition: join in wrong or injury, with another, Th.1.37, X.An.2.6.27: abs., Th.1.39, Pl.R.496d, SIG167.42 , etc.; wrong or injure in addition, Iamb.VP9.46; Sor.1.79:—Pass., to be wronged alike, D.56.44, etc.; Id.21.126

συνᾴδω.definition: = , sing with or together; generally, to be in accord with, agree with, Ar.Lys.1088, Pl.Phd.92c, etc.; Id.R.432a; S.OT1113: abs., to be in unison, opp. Heraclit.10, cf. Pl.Prt.333a

συναείδω.definition: poet. for Arat.752, Theoc.10.24, Hymn. in IG42.131.3

συναηδίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be displeased together, Ph.1.405

συναθετέω.definition: declare spurious as well, Sch.Ar.Ra.1500, Phot.Bibl.p.512 B

συναθροίζω.definition: pf. POxy.1253.5 (iv; of things, gather into one mass, Ar.Lys.585 ; bring the body together, Pl.Ti.44d:—Pass., . . . . . . Id.R.422d; to sum up, therefore, ib.563d; Id.Ti.25b; Arist.HA546b18; Lycurg.110; Thphr.Ign.12, …

συνάθροισις.definition: collecting, Arist.GA739b10; of persons, gathering, Sch.S.OC537

συναθροισμός.definition: collection, union; a rhetor. figure, by which dissimilar things were associated, Alex.Fig.p.17 S., Quint. Inst.8.4.27

συναιθριάζω.definition: clear at the same time, v.l. in X.An.4.4.10

συναίνεσις.definition: approval, consent, assent, Ph.1.382, al., Plu.2.258b; POxy.2110.8 , cf. 506.54 , etc

συναινέω.definition: c. acc., concede, give, A.Ag.484; agree upon, SIG633.83 : but most freq. c. Adj. neut., agree to, S.OC1508; Id.Fr.368 , X.Cyr.4.2.47, etc.; grant, E.Rh.172, cf. X.Cyr.8.5.20, An.7.7.31

συναίρεσις.definition: taking or drawing together, Longin.10.3; Ath.11.489f; contraction, closing, Sor.2.59. 2. contraction of front, opp. Ascl.Tact.11.7; shortening, reduction of an estimated distance, Ptol.Geog.1.8.3; Sor.Fract.19 . 3. ag…

συναιρετίστης.definition: member of the same faction, of planets, Vett.Val.55.24, al., Cat.Cod.Astr.7.215, al.; misspelt in Cat.Cod.Astr.8.256, Sch.Ptol.Tetr.96, and ib.99

συναισθάνομαι.definition: perceive simultaneously, Arist.HA534b18; share in perception or sense, Arist.EE1245b22; Plu.Sol.18

συναίσθησις.definition: joint-sensation, joint-; awareness, Plu.2.75b,76b, Arr.Epict.1.2.30, Procl.Inst.39, Herm.in Phdr.p.94A., Dam.Pr.3; self- consciousness, Plot.3.8.4; conscious perception, Phld.Rh.2.6 S.; Arr.Epict.2.11.1; Sor.1.49; ib.…

συναιτέω.definition: demand together with, = servo competere, Gloss.:— Med., join in demanding for oneself, POxy.54.31

συναιχμάζω.definition: fight along with or together, AP15.50: c. dat., Nonn.D.2.201, al

συναιχμαλωτίζω.definition: take captive along with, S.E.M.1.295, cf. Theol.Ar.40

συναιωρέομαι.definition: Pass., to be swayed with, Pl.Phd.112b, cf. Plu.2.564d

συνακαταληπτέομαι.definition: Pass., to be incomprehensible together, S.E.M.1.243, 11.38

συνακολασταίνω.definition: live dissolutely with, Plu.Demetr.24; Id.Sull.2, cf. 2.140b

συνακολουθέω.definition: follow along with or closely; follow with the mind, attend to, Arist.EN1100b4; follow an argument completely, Pl.Phlb.25c, Lg.629a; follow him in a matter, ib.792c; Arist.Ph.188b26, Thphr.Sens.72

συνακοντίζω.definition: throw a javelin along with or at once; strike with many javelins, Plb.1.43.6:—Pass., Id.1.34.7, 11.1.9, al

συνακροάομαι.definition: listen together, be a fellow-hearer, Pl.Mx.235b; to be his hearer with us, Id.Sis.387b

συναλγέω.definition: share in suffering, S.Aj.253 : c. dat; abs., reveal them to us who are partners in his sorrow, S.Aj.283, cf. E.Alc.633, HF1202, Antipho3.2.8, Pl.R.462d; in one's soul, D.18.287; Arist.Pr.887a16

συνάλειμμα.definition: salve, Dsc.3.137, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.10.18.5, Id.in Rh.Mus.58.78, al., Sor.2.32

συναλίζω.definition: aor. Hdt.1.176, ib.125:—bring together, collect, assemble, Hdt.1.125; ib.176, cf. 2.111; . . X.HG1.1.30:—Pass., come together, assemble, Hdt.1.62, 5.15,102, X.An.7.3.48, etc.; Id.Cyr.1.2.15; of things, Hp.Oss.15; Aris…

συναλίσγομαι.definition: to be sullied with, c. dat., Aristeas142

συναλίσκομαι.definition: Pass., to be taken captive together, Plu.Comp.Dion. Brut.3, Ael.NA11.12; with one, D.L.2.105

συναλλαγή.definition: interchange, esp. for purposes of; commerce, dealings, E.Hipp.652; in the dealings of men with the immortals, S.OT34; D.H.1.60; covenant, contract, Id.6.22, POxy.70.4 ; OGI669.18

συνάλλαγμα.definition: covenant, contract, D.24.213; generally, in pl., dealings, transactions, Archyt.3, Hp.Medic.1; i.e. sales, loans, etc., distd. from i.e. crimes of force or fraud, Arist.EN1131a2, cf. Rh.1376b12; LXXIs.58.6; OGI229.54

συναλλαγματογράφος.definition: notary, recorder of contracts, ib.42.6 , POxy.237viii 36

συναλλακτής.definition: mediator, negotiator, Hsch; an official concerned with the tax on sales , POxy.43vii 4, al

συνάλλαξις.definition: contract, PFay.11.22 , PTeb.6.32, 61. 22; right of disposal by contract, BGU1120.52

συναλλάσσω.definition: Att. pf. SIG742.55; reconcile, Th.1.24; opp. X.Vect.5.8; Act.Ap.7.26: abs., Pl.Lg.930a:—Pass. and Med., to be reconciled or come to terms with, make a league or alliance with, Th.8.90, X.An.1.2.1: abs., make peace, Th…

συναλλοιόω.definition: alter at the same time, Arist.Phgn.808b12, Thphr.CP2.14.3, Gal.1.403, Dam.Pr.280

συναλοάω.definition: Ep. aor. out together; grind to powder, crush, Hippon. in PSI9.1089.4, Theoc.22.128, Plu.Marc.15, Opp.C.1.268, Q.S.11.472, etc

συναλωνιάζω.definition: keep the threshing festival together, Suid

συναμαρτάνω.definition: sin along with or together, Plu.2.53c, App.Ill.8, Chor.23.60F.-R

συναμιλλάομαι.definition: Med., contend or struggle together, E.HF1206 , Plu.2.786f

συναμύνω.definition: fut. E.IA62:—join in assisting, l.c.:—Med., Eratosth.Cat.33, Ael.NA3.46

συναμφιβάλλομαι.definition: Pass., to be matter of doubt together, Eust.316.26

συνάμφω.definition: both together, Pl.Plt.278c; with the Art. in sg., Arist.Metaph.1043a22, cf. Int.20b37; Str.2.4.5, cf. 2.1.29; Id.1.2.36

συναναβακχεύω.definition: break into Bacchic frenzy together, Lib.Or.18.75

συναναβιβάζω.definition: causal of Al.Ge.50.25, Orib.49.23.22, 49.24.24:—Pass., of the accent, to be thrown back together, A.D.Adv.135.2

συναναβόσκομαι.definition: Pass., grow up together with, c. dat., Plu.2.409a

συναναγιγνώσκω.definition: read together, ib.180d; ib.97a, cf. Gal.18.321:— Pass., Phot.Bibl.p.145 B., al

συναναγκάζω.definition: press together, compress, Hp.Art.37; join or assist in compelling, Arist.Pol.1256b7; D.58.7, Prooem.10, cf. PCair.Zen.149 , PPetr.3p.69 :—Pass., to be compelled at the same time, c.inf., X.Hier.3.9, D.26.10, Arist.Ath…

συνανάγνωσις.definition: reading together, Plu.2.700c, Phot.Bibl.p.99 B., etc

συναναγράφω.definition: register or record at the same time, D.S.17.1:—Pass., Aeschin.2.83

συναναδεύω.definition: mix into a paste with, Hippiatr.34

συναναδίδωμι.definition: give back along with, Luc.Symp.15; distribute together, Gal.18.152, Alex. Aphr.Pr.1.5:—Pass., prob. in Sor.1.88

συναναζέω.definition: make to boil together, Dsc.1.30, Hippiatr.34, Aët.9.31: intr., Dsc.1.55

συναναθεματίζω.definition: pronounce a curse together, Phot.Bibl.p.286 B

συναναθλέω.definition: join in accomplishing a task, Eun.VSp.500 B

συναναθυμιάομαι.definition: Pass., to be burnt together, Arist.Pr.907a38

συναναιρέω.definition: take up together with; destroy together with, Isoc.Ep.2.3, Plb.5.11.5, etc.; Id.6.46.7; simply, destroy at the same time, Phld.Mus.p.37 K.:—Pass., to be destroyed together with, Lycurg.60: abs., Diog.Oen.58

συνανακαθαίρω.definition: aor. assist in cleaning up, IG11.163 A 56, 287 A 49

συνανακάμπτω.definition: intr., return along with, Plb.8.27.6; walk backwards and forwards with, D.L.2.127, cf. 139

συνανάκειμαι.definition: Pass., recline together at table, Ev.Matt.9.10, etc

συνανακεφαλαιόω.definition: sum up briefly, f.l. for in D.H.Th.12

συνανακίρνημι.definition: mix up with, S.E.P.3.59 , cf. HeroSpir.1Praef.p.14 S.:—also Pass. Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.35.21

συνανακλίνομαι.definition: Pass., lie down along with, esp. in bed or at table, Luc.Asin.3; = concubo, Gloss

συνανακομίζω.definition: in Med., help one to recover, Plb.4.25.8

συνανακόπτω.definition: beat up together, Heliod. ap. Orib.44.14.11, Gal.13.31

συνανακράω.definition: late form for in Pass. Phot.s.v

συναναλαμβάνω.definition: take up along with, Plu.2.214f; receive, BGU918.9

συναναλάμπω.definition: shine forth together, Ph.2.141: c. acc., shed lustre on at the same time, SIG798.3

συναναληψία.definition: restoration to a healthy state, Sor.1.29

συναναλύω.definition: Elean in Med., remit a debt, Schwyzer 418.7

συναναμαλάσσω.definition: soften along with or together, Dsc.Eup.2.25, Orib.Fr.75, Aët.7.84

συναναμείγνυμι.definition: mix up together, Hp.Nat.Mul.97, Ath.5.177b:—Pass., c. dat., Thphr.HP8.8.3, Phld.D.3.9; associate with, Clearch.25; 1 Ep.Cor.5.9; of two bodies of men meeting, Plu.Phil.21; is part of their nature, Luc.Cont.15

συνανάμιγος.definition: mixed up with, included among, POxy.718.16, al

συναναμιμνήσκω.definition: remind together, of things, Plu.2.397e; bring to mind together with, Gal.15.510:—Pass., recall together with, Pl.Lg.897e

συνανανεόομαι.definition: Med., join in renewing, Plb.12.6A.3; to renew the term , PEnteux.15.5

συναναξηραίνω.definition: dry up at the same time, Ath.Med. ap. Orib.9.12.11

συναναπάλλομαι.definition: Pass., fly forth along with, Philostr.Im.1.24

συναναπαύομαι.definition: Pass., sleep with, D.H.Rh.9.4, cf. Plu.2.125a, Hld.6.8; to be refreshed, receive comfort along with, Ep.Rom.15.32

συναναπείθω.definition: assist in persuading, Th.6.88, Isoc.4.46; Plu.Publ.21

συναναπλάσσω.definition: help in refashioning, Max.Tyr.24.5; make up into pills, Dsc.4.164

συναναπλέκω.definition: entwine also, Aq.Jb. 39.13:—Pass; mix up together, Alex.Trall.Febr.4

συναναπληρόω.definition: fill up at the same time, Thphr.HP4.13.4 ; Nicom.Harm.6; make up or compensate, Plb.22.20.7; Plu.2.795b

συναναπράσσω.definition: Att. join in exacting payment, X.An.7.7.14

συναναπτύω.definition: spit up at the same time, aor. Pass. Gal.8.262

συναναρριπτέω.definition: throw up together, v.l. for Luc.Zeux.10

συναναρτάομαι.definition: Pass., to be closely connected, D.C.38.24 codd

συνανασκευάζω.definition: refute along with, S.E.M.7.214, Gal.Opt.Doctr.6:—Pass., c. dat., Phld.Sign.12, al

συνανασπάω.definition: draw up together, Ph.Bel.95.1, Ph.1.643, 2.513, Gal.UP8.14, Luc.Cat.18

συναναστομόω.definition: join by a mouth or opening, Gal.UP15.4:—Pass., to be joined by a mouth or opening, open into, Arist.Mu.393b1, cf. Gal.2.375, al.: so in Act., Peripl.M.Rubr.64

συναναστόμωσις.definition: in pl., of supposed communications between arteries and veins, Erasistr. ap. Gal.4.709, cf. 8.352, 11.152

συναναστρέφω.definition: turn back together, intr., J.BJ5.2.2; Pass. and Med., live together, associate with, D.S.3.58, Plu.Lyc.17, Hierocl.p.58 A.; SIG534.8 ; Carneisc.Herc.1027.13, cf. Phld.Rh.1.377 S.:—so in Act., Agatharch.42

συναναστροφή.definition: living with, intercourse, Epicur.Sent.Vat.18, LXXWi.8.16, Phld.D.3 Fr. 87, J.AJ18.6.9; Supp.Epigr. 7.825.7 : pl., D.S.4.4, Arr.Epict.1.9.5, Hierocl.p.58 A

συνανασῴζω.definition: restore along with, Plb.4.25.6, cf. 3.77.6:— Pass., Str.10.4.15

συνανατείνω.definition: extend at the same time, Gal.18.369:—Pass., Id.2.583

συνανατέλλω.definition: rise or grow up with or together with, Ael.VH13.1; of stars, etc., Hipparch.2.4.1, Gem.17.39, al., PGiss.3.2 , Ptol.Tetr.79, Nonn.D.1.175, 3.431

συνανατίθημι.definition: help in putting on; join in dedicating, IG22.1299.93, Luc.Phal.2.7

συνανατρέπω.definition: overturn or defeat together, Ph.1.696; confuse , Gal.10.141

συνανατρέφω.definition: rear along with, Inscr.Prien.107.20 , Conon19 , etc

συνανατρίβω.definition: rub up together, Dsc.1.25:—Pass., to be rubbed against, D.L.7.22; wrestle with, Epict.Ench.33.6, Diog.Ep.35.2

συναναφαίνω.definition: display at the same time, Dam.Pr.27,246:—Pass., appear together with, Demetr.Eloc.6, Luc.Salt.7, etc

συναναφέρω.definition: fut. prob.in Hsch.:— carry up; Astron., rise with, in Pass., Hipparch.2.3.30, Vett.Val.6.10

συναναφθέγγομαι.definition: cry out at the same time, Plu.Mar.19

συναναφορά.definition: referring at the same time; rising together, Ptol.Alm.2.7 tit., Heph.Astr.2.10, Cat.Cod.Astr.1.138

συναναφύρω.definition: knead or mix up together, PHolm.26.39:—Pass., Gal.15.577: also, wallow together, Luc.Anach.1; Ath.13.567a; Luc.Sat.28

συναναχαλάω.definition: relax at the same time, Sor.1.31

συναναχρώννυμι.definition: impart by mixture or contact: metaph., impart, Gp. l.c.:— Pass., D.S.3.16: metaph., to be imbued and infected, Plu.2.4a; ib.975f:—Med., infecting the citizens, Id.Agis10

συνανδρόομαι.definition: Pass., grow up along with, Hp.Prorrh.2.9; J.BJ1.23.1

συνάνειμι.definition: go up together, Ph.1.461; grow up with, Ael.NA6.63

συνανέλκω.definition: draw up together, Thphr.CP5.6.3, Ph.2.513, Sch.Ar.Pax706

συνανέρχομαι.definition: come or rise up with, A.R.2.913, Arat.561, prob.l. in Ph.1.311; BGU638.10

συνανήκω.definition: have reference also to a thing, Phot.Bibl.p.162 B

συνανθρωπεύομαι.definition: live with or among men, Arist.HA599a21; domesticated animals, ib.542a27, Thphr.HP3.2.2, etc.:—later in Act., Porph.Abst.1.36, 4.22

συνανίστημι.definition: make to stand up or rise together; Pass. with aor. 2 Act., rise at the same time, Id.An.7.3.35; with one, Id.Cyr.5.1.5

συνανοίγω.definition: open in company with, . . IG12.91.16; SIG799.8 :—Pass. Them.Or.20.235c

συνανταίρω.definition: rise against together, Eulogius ap.Phot.Bibl.p.282 B

συνάντημα.definition: incident, occurrence; visitation, of plague, etc., ib.Ex.9.14, PMag.Leid.W.18.5, Anon. in Rh.1.646 W.; nightmare, Cyran.31

συνάντησις.definition: meeting, E.Ion535 , LXXGe.18.2, al., v.l. in Ev.Matt.8.34; PCair.Zen. 541.8 ; in chance-meetings, D.H.4.66; encounter, controversy, Hp.Decent.3; of heavenly bodies, Vett.Val.147.29, Paul.Al.R.3

συναντιλαμβάνομαι.definition: Med., help in gaining a thing; c. dat., take part with, help, LXXEx.18.22, Ps.88.22, Ev.Luc.10.40

συναντιμεσουρανέω.definition: to be in the opposite meridian at the same time, Cat.Cod.Astr. 8.230

συνανύω.definition: accomplish together, App.Pun.47; intr., arrive together, Arist.Phgn.813b19, Plu.Alc.27, etc.--Hsch.also cites

συναξιόω.definition: join in thinking fit, c.acc. et inf., X.Cyr.7.1.15; join in demanding, BGU1011.15

συναοριστέομαι.definition: acquire indefiniteness at the same time, A.D.Synt.306.22

συναπειλέω.definition: threaten at the same time, Luc.Demon.15; . . J.AJ20.2.4

συναπεργάζομαι.definition: help in finishing or completing; elaborate the plots by language and gestures, Arist.Po.1455a22,30; of an orator, help the effect by the use of gestures, etc., Id.Rh.1386a31

συναπέρχομαι.definition: depart together with, Id.GA725b14; Id.Mete.383a19: abs., being passed with the urine, Ruf.Ren.Ves.3.5; branching off together, Gal.19.522

συναπευθύνω.definition: make straight together, help to guide, Plu.2.426c,1027a, Heliod. ap. Orib.48.33.7

συναπέχω.definition: to be remote from at the same time; trans., receive also, PFay.14.7 , PGen.23.7 , etc

συναποβαίνω.definition: disembark together with, Hdt.6.92; go away from it together, Philostr.VA3.15; dismount together with, Procop.Gaz.p.170 B

συναποβάλλω.definition: lose at the same time, D.S.3.7, Plu.Phil.21:—Pass., Gal.14.588

συναποβιάζομαι.definition: Med., assist in checking or repressing by force, Arist.HA581a24, Pr.962a7

συναποβλέπω.definition: fix one's gaze on as well, Aristid.Or.19.3

συναπογίγνομαι.definition: to be absent together, Anon.in Rh.1.607 W

συναπογράφομαι.definition: Med., enter one's name together; register at the same time, PGrenf. 2.49.9 , etc.:—Pass., Sammelb.7440.35

συναπογυμνόομαι.definition: Pass., to be stripped naked along with, Sch.Hes.Op.753

συναποδείκνυμι.definition: demonstrate together, Euc.Phaen.p.98; appoint at the same time, in Pass., Inscr.Prien. 82.18, al

συναποδημέω.definition: go abroad or travel with, Arist.Pol.1314b13; with one, D.S.4.4, Plu.Crass.3, Brut.3, al., POxy.1122.10 ; IG22.641.15, cf. Luc.DMeretr.9.1

συναποδιδράσκω.definition: run away along with, Ar.Ra.81, cf. J.BJ1.8.6; aor. 1 part. Luc.Asin.27

συναποδίδωμι.definition: repay at the same time, BGU853.13 (ii; render or recount together, Ptol.Geog.1.2.4 , Sor.1.1; administer at the same time, Ruf. ap.Aët.11.29, S.E.M.8.1, etc.; is rendered or represented with the idea, Id.P.1.11

συναποδύομαι.definition: Med., strip off from oneself or put off together, Philostr.V A6.11; Men.Prot.p.1 D.: abs., strip oneself for a contest along with another, Plu.2.94c, cf.Ath.1.15c

συναποθνήσκω.definition: die together with, Hdt.3.16, 5.47; Isoc.Ep.8.5: abs., opp. 2 Ep.Cor.7.3, Ath.6.249b; title of comedy by Diphilus, Ter.Adelph.Prol.6; Gal.15.68; Pl.Phd.88d; i.e. cling to one until death, Hp.Aph.2.39, cf. Arist.GA775b34

συναποικίζω.definition: in Pass., go as colonists together, Luc.Nav.3

συναποίχομαι.definition: to have gone away together, Aret.CD1.4

συναποκαθαίρομαι.definition: Pass., to be washed off together with, c. dat., Dsc.1.8

συναποκαθίστημι.definition: accompany a person on the return; Pass., subside together with, Gal.8.166, 9.525, Procl.Inst.209, Aët.5.121

συναποκαλέω.definition: call by a name also, Plu.Fr.2.2

συναποκαλύπτω.definition: disclose at the same time, Iamb.Comm.Math.34

συναποκατάστασις.definition: joint return, Ptol.Tetr.7, cf. Alm.9.3, Vett.Val.233.25, Cat.Cod. Astr.8.238

συναποκινδυνεύω.definition: encounter danger along with, Longin.22.4, Hld.6.7

συναποκλείω.definition: shut up altogether, LXX1 Ki.1.5, 6 cod. A

συναποκλίνω.definition: turn aside together with, pf. Pass; intr., turn aside together, Plu.2.790e: abs., J.BJ1.24.2; Lib.Descr.18.3

συναποκλύζω.definition: wash away with or at once, Philum.Ven.1

συναποκομίζω.definition: carry away together, D.S.1.20, 3.15:— Pass., J.AJ14.4.5

συναποκόπτω.definition: cut off together, Plu.2.529c:— Pass., Gal.14.247; of a final letter or syllable, A.D.Conj.255.6

συναποκρίνομαι.definition: Pass., to be secreted and carried off together, Arist.HA581b30; to be extruded, of the afterbirth, Sor.1.70

συναποκρύπτω.definition: join in concealing, Ael.NA7.25; conceal together, LXXEp.Je.48, Lib.Descr.13.4, etc

συναποκτείνω.definition: kill together, Antipho5.39, Aeschin.2.148; with one, D.C.Fr.11.18

συναποκυλίνδω.definition: aor. roll away together with, Sch.B Il.23.730

συναπολαμβάνω.definition: receive in common or at once, esp. that; Pass., to be entirely suppressed, Hp.Prorrh.2.24

συναπολαύω.definition: share in the enjoyment, Arist.HA623a24; share in the good or evil of . ., . . Arist.Pr.883a15; in bad sense, make it suffer with them, Id.Pol.1303b32; Them.Or.1.7b, Max. Tyr.18.9; Gal.18.74; cf. II.1

συναπολήγω.definition: cease along with, to have the feet ending with it, Philostr.Her.1.3; Id.Im.2.18, cf. Them.Or.3.47a

συναπολιθόω.definition: petrify at the same time, Pass., c. dat., Sch.Lyc.843

συναπόλλυμι.definition: destroy together, Antipho5.82; destroy one's friends as well as oneself, Th.6.12; Hyp.Lyc.19; lose the money also, D.34.2; one thing with another, Plu.Cat.Mi.38:—Pass., perish together, Th.2.60, Lys.12.88: c. dat., Hd…

συναπολογέομαι.definition: join in defending, D.24.157, 159, Hyp.Lyc.Fr.3, etc.; Lex ap.D.24.23; for hire, Lycurg.138; is prob. cj. for in Din.1.28

συναπομαραίνομαι.definition: Pass., fade away and die together, X.Smp.8.14; Plu.Phil.18; of the pulse, Gal.8.479, Paul.Aeg.2.11.23

συναπομειόω.definition: diminish at the same time, Just.Nov.163

συναπονοέομαι.definition: Med., share in folly with, D.S.34/35.2.26, Ph.2.160, etc.: aor. Pass. in med. sense, ib.118, J.AJ5.2.9

συναποπαύομαι.definition: Med., leave off together, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.6.20.12, Gal.7.408, Ach.Tat.Intr.Arat.28

συναποπέμπω.definition: send off together, X.Cyr.3.1.2 ; send out as well, Gal.2.523

συναποπίπτω.definition: fall off at the same time, Id.17.672

συναποπτύω.definition: spit out together, Gal.8.262, Philum. ap. Orib.45.29.47

συναπορρέω.definition: run off together, Thphr.CP6.17.1, Agatharch.27, Plu.2.1005e

συναπορρήγνυμι.definition: break or tear off together, Id.Mar.12, J.BJ5.6.4

συναπορρύπτομαι.definition: Med., wash together with, Philostr.Her.2.2, cf.Ph.1.115

συναποσβέννυμι.definition: put out, extinguish with or together, AP7.367; Sor.1.28; Them.Or.4.59d:—Pass., with aor. pf. to be put out together, D.S.37.2.14, Plu.Marc.24, etc.; AP5.278

συναποσεμνύνω.definition: exalt or extol highly together, D.S.1.92

συναποσπάω.definition: tear or drag off together or with, PRyl.114.11 , cf. Jul.Ep.14, v.l. in Gal.UP8.14:—Pass., Apollod.2.7.7

συναποστέλλω.definition: dispatch together with, Th.6.88; PCair.Zen.18.5 ; ib.439.3 ; join in dispatching, Is.6.27, X.HG5.2.37, etc

συναποστερέω.definition: help to strip or cheat, one; help in abstracting, Pl.Lg.948c

συναποτέμνω.definition: cut off together, Gal.2.531:—Pass., Ruf.Sat. Gon.10

συναποτερματίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be conterminous with, Sch.Od.19.242

συναποτίθεμαι.definition: Med., put off at the same time; abs., abdicate together with, App.BC2.32

συναποτίκτω.definition: join in producing, Pl.Tht.156e; produce at the same time, Plu.Cor.1

συναποτίλλω.definition: pluck off along with or together, Dsc.1.8

συναποτίνω.definition: join in paying, SIG546 B 18 ; PEleph.2.11

συναποτρέπω.definition: turn away together, Socr.Ep.1.9; Zaleuc. ap. Stob.4.2.19

συναποφαίνω.definition: prove together, Phot.Bibl.p.172 B; in earlier writers only Med., assert likewise or together, . . Aeschin.2.42; agree in asserting, Isoc.12.264; Str.15.1.6; Id.2.1.20; c. inf., Plb.4.31.5, etc.; Str.15.1.11

συναποφάσκω.definition: deny at the same time, Ps.-Alex.Aphr. in Metaph.627.38, Dam.Pr.445

συναποφέρω.definition: help to carry off; carry off with, Gal.5.303; Alciphr.2.3:—Pass., to be borne along with, Demad.15, cf. Plu.2.626b, Gal.UP1.19; Theo Sm.p.176 H.:—Med., take away with one, Gal.6.178, Ath.6.273f

συναποφθίνω.definition: aor. 1 destroy together, Opp.H.5.576:—Pass., perish together, ib.587

συναποχράομαι.definition: exploit together, Plb.Fr.119; join in peculation, PAmh.2.79.26
