συνάπτω.definition: in physical sense, of dancers, Ar.Th.955 ; in sign of friendship. E.Ba.198, cf. IA832, Pl.Lg.698d; E.Ph.106; but bind them fast, Id.Ba.615 , cf. 546 ; meet him, Id.Ion538 , 663; Id.Ph.37; meet in full career, ib.1101;…

συναπωθέω.definition: help to push off or back, Luc.Tox.19, Orib.47.5.13:— Pass., Arist.Pr.963a20, Gal.6.197

συναραρίσκω.definition: intr. in pf., the song hangs well together, h.Ap.164; for Luc.Zeux.8; A.R.2.1112, cf. 1.497

συναραχνόομαι.definition: to be covered as with a spider's web, v

συναρθμέω.definition: to be fitted together, to agree . . , A.R.4.418

συναρθμόομαι.definition: Pass., to be closed, of the cervix uteri, Hp.Mul.2.169 as cited by Gal. and Erot

συναρθρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be joined by articulation; later in Act., attach the article, An.Ox.1.49

συναριθμέω.definition: reckon in, take into account, enumerate; Med., join in receiving payment, POxy.1208.17

συναρίθμησις.definition: counting up, enumeration; sum of the letters of a word taken as arithmetical signs , Anatolius ap.Theol.Ar.37

συναριστάω.definition: take breakfast or luncheon with, Ar.Av.1486, cf. Aeschin.1.43, Alex.47, Luc.Asin.50: abs., Phld.Lib.p.56 O.: name of a play by Menander

συναρκέομαι.definition: acquiesce in, put up with, Thphr.Char.3.6

συναρμόζω.definition: Att. Pl.Ti.32b, etc.: Dor. aor; in physical sense, fit together, Th.4.100; . . close them, E.Ph.1451, cf. IT1167; Thphr.Sens.9; Hp.Aër.9, Arist.HA541b4:—Pass., Hdt.1.163; Pl.R.412a; to be joined in wedlock, Arist.Mir.…

συναρμολογέω.definition: compagino, Gloss.:—Pass., to be fitted or framed together, Ep.Eph.2.21, 4.16

συναροτριάω.definition: bring under the plough, in Pass., prob. in Milet.6.36

συναρπάζω.definition: fut. E.IA535, Luc.DDeor.8.1; seize and pin them together, E.Hec.1163, cf. Lys.Fr.75.4:—Med., of a wrestler, Ar.Lys.437

συναρρωστέω.definition: to be sick with or together, Gal.15.241, 17.423

συναρτάω.definition: knit or join together, E.Med.564; metaph., Epicur.Nat.14.9: mostly in Pass., Arist.EN1178a19; Id.Cael.270b9; to be implicated in, c. dat., Phld.Sign.35; to be involved in . . , Plu.Num.20; to be always engaged in . . …

συνάρτησις.definition: junction, union; connexion, cohesion of premisses with one another and with the conclusion in a syllogism, Stoic.2.79; of the clauses in a conditional sentence, Plu.2.387a, S.E.P.2.111

συναρχαιρεσιάζω.definition: help in canvassing for election, Plu.2.97a, 200c

συναρχιεράομαι.definition: to be a colleague in the high- priesthood, with one, CIG4385.12

σύναρχος.definition: partner in office, colleague, Arist.Pol.1287b31, IG5.124 , 9.706 , al., v.l. in D.C.67.15

συναρχοστατέομαι.definition: Med., take part in elections, IG9.32.13

συνάρχω.definition: rule jointly with, Hdt.8.130; to be a colleague or partner in office, c. dat., Th.7.31: colleague in office, Id.6.25, 8.27, Lys.12.52, Pl.R.463b, freq. in Inscrr., IG12.304.6, al.; Hyp.Lyc.16; Lys.12.79

συνασελγαίνω.definition: to be a companion in debauchery, D.C.79.19

συνασθενέω.definition: to be ill together with, Chor.Milt.68

συνασκέω.definition: help one to practise; train, educate, or discipline fully, D.L.4.67, 6.23; D.H.Lys.11; Id.Rh.7.4; S.E.M.1.190; Eun.VSp.487 B.; D.L.2.72:—Pass., Plu.Cleom.20; . . Phalar.Ep.67.1; Sor.Vit.Hippocr.4; D.L.3.29; Phld.Rh.1.…

συνάσκησις.definition: training, opp. Phld.Rh.1.1, cf. D.H.2.74, S.E.M.7.146, 11.248; military training, Ael.Tact.3.1; Lyd.Mag.3.33

συνασμενίζω.definition: rejoice or be glad with, EM655.25; take pleasure in the same things as, Ph.2.259: hence Id.Fr.75 H

συνασπάζομαι.definition: greet at the same time, PUniv.Giss.20.40

συνασπίζω.definition: fut. Hsch.:— to be a shield-fellow or; = Plb.4.64.6, Phld.Ir.p.52 W., Plu.Rom.18, Ascl.Tact.4.1, etc.; fight side by side, Luc.Pisc.1; stand in line with them, D.S.17.84, cf. 4.16

συνασπισμός.definition: holding of the shields together, fighting in close order, D.S.16.3, Arr.Tact.11.4, Plu.Tim.27, etc

συνασταχύω.definition: to be full of ears of corn, Arat.1050

συναστρία.definition: favourable conjunction of the stars; friendship, Ptol.Tetr.193, Procl.Par.Ptol.267; Cat.Cod.Astr.5.210

συνασφαλίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be fortified, Sch.D Od.7.45

συνασχημονέω.definition: join in unseemly conduct, Plu.2.64d, D.C.79.13

συνασχολέομαι.definition: Pass., share in business or occupation with, Plu.Phil.4, cf. Id.2.95d,e

συνατιμάζω.definition: insult or dishonour at the same time, Ph.2.201:— Pass., Manetho ap.J.Ap.1.26; Plu.Agis17

συνατμίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be joined in vaporous form, D.L.6.73

συνατονέω.definition: to be relaxed or languid together , Sor.1.38,46, Gal.13.194

συνατυχέω.definition: to be unlucky with or together, Lycurg.131; D.S.13.52, Plu.2.64c, etc

συναυαίνω.definition: dry quite up, Hp.Aër.9, E.Cyc.463:—Pass., to be dried up also, Hp.Loc.Hom.40, Pl.Phdr.251d

συναυλίζομαι.definition: Pass., have dealings with, Cat.Cod. Astr.7.110; congregate, Babr.106.6: also aor. Med., Phalar.Ep.34: freq. v.l. for as in X.Cyr.1.2.15, Act.Ap.1.4

συναυξάνω.definition: impf. Suid. s.v. (also; join or assist in increasing, Democr.184; X.Oec.3.10; Arist.EN1175a30, cf. Thphr.Sens.18, Ign.27, Sor.1.29; . . Klio 15.41 ; Supp.Epigr.2.270.6 ; X.Cyr.8.3.21; Supp.Epigr.4.720.15 ; join in exa…

συναύξησις.definition: growing together, common growth, Hp.Art.53; Arist.HA622b15; simply, enlargement, growth, of the breasts, Sor.1.76; ib.10; increase, opp. ib.20; aggravation, Herod. Med. ap. Orib.5.30.6: abs., Plb.1.6.3

συναυξομειόομαι.definition: Pass., increase and decrease together with, Str.Chr.17.38

συναφαιρέω.definition: take away at the same time, A.D.Conj.255.4 ; in surgery, Sor.Fract.7 , Gal.2.263, Aët.7.64; Max. Tyr.2.1:—Med., assist in rescuing, Th.8.92

συναφανίζομαι.definition: Pass., disappear or perish together with, D.H.1.1, cf.Str.6.1.6, 12.8.17, etc.: abs., S.E.M.5.51

συναφέψω.definition: boil off or down together, Dsc.5.8, Gal.6.538, Orib.Fr.60: pf. part. Pass. Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.75

συναφιδρύομαι.definition: Pass., to be dedicated together, Sch.Pi.N.1.3

συναφομοιόω.definition: make quite like, Plu.2.52e, cf. 51d, Antig.Mir.25

συνάχθομαι.definition: fut. Aeschin.3.242, Thphr.Char.29.5: aor. opt. D.20.113, etc.:—to be troubled or grieved along with or together, condole with, c. dat. pers., Hdt.8.142, cf. Isoc.4.112, 6.103, D.20.113, etc.: c. dat. rei, at a thing, …

συνάχνυμαι.definition: Pass., to be grieved along with, Q.S.2.625, Nonn.D.11.213

συνδάκνω.definition: bite together, of a horse, take the bit in his teeth and run away, X.Eq.6.9; crush by closing the teeth, Arist.HA612a24, 621b2; hold the breath, Cerc.1:—Pass., smart exceedingly, LXXTo.11.12

συνδάμναμαι.definition: Pass., to be subdued together, Nic.Al.173

συνδανείζομαι.definition: Med . . get together by borrowing; to be a joint borrower, PGrenf.2.18.8 , PRein.26.12

συνδείκνυμι.definition: in Med., demonstrate also, Gal.15.651; the road which has been pointed out jointly, OGI225.42

συνδειπνέω.definition: dine or sup with, Epich.35, cf. X.HG4.1.6; Is.3.14, Test. ap. D.21.121: abs., dine or sup with others or together, Pl.Smp.174e, 217c, X.Cyr.4.5.9, Lys.1.22, PTeb.43.18 , etc.; the members of a picnic party, X.Mem.3.14.2

συνδείπνιον.definition: dining-room, PCair.Zen.764.45 (iii; = sq., Call.Cer.73, D.S.14.42, Ath.4.140c

σύνδειπνον.definition: common meal or banquet, Ar.Fr.153, Pl.Smp.172b, Lys.Fr.66, Cic.Fam.9.24.3, etc

σύνδειπνος.definition: companion at table, E.Ion1172, X.Cyr.3.2.25, 8.2.3, LXXSi.9.16; X.An.2.5.27, Cyr.2.2.28; Plu.2.660b; title of a satyric drama by S., Cic.QF2.16.3, etc.; members of a dining-club, opp. PTeb.118.4,10

συνδεκάζω.definition: bribe all together, X.Ath.3.7; Lex ap.D.46.26; Aeschin.1.86, etc.; is a freq. f.l

συνδενδρόομαι.definition: Pass., become a tree together, Lib.Eth.11.4

σύνδενδρος.definition: thickly-wooded, Dicaearch.1.8, Plb.12.4.2, Sch.Il.Oxy.1086.10; Arr.Tact.27.4; Babr.43.1; in a thickly-wooded place, Plu.2.310e

συνδέομαι.definition: join in entreating, c. dat., Plu.Caes.66; . . Pl.Prm.136e; beg of him also . . , Id.Ep.318c; something of a person, D.36.57

συνδεσμεύω.definition: bind together, Plb.3.42.8; later Gal.2.268, Charito2.2, Sch.D.T.p.61 H

σύνδεσμος.definition: heterocl. pl. E. (v; metaph., bond of union; the bond that keeps the state together, of good citizens, Pl.R.520a, cf.Plt.310a; . . Id.Lg.921c; Id.R.616c; Arist.EN1162a27; Ep.Col.3.14

συνδεσποτεύω.definition: Astrol., rule at the same time, Sch.Ptol.Tetr.38

συνδηλόω.definition: make altogether clear, Arist.Rh.1395a27:—Pass., Thphr.HP1.1.8; to be signified, A.D.Synt.312.21; Gal.16.513

συνδημαγωγέω.definition: help in captivating the populace, Plu.Pomp.2; joined with his calamity in persuading the mob, Id.Caes.5:—Pass., App.BC3.24

συνδημιουργέω.definition: create together, Jul.Or.5.167b, Iamb. ap. Stob.1.49.67, Hierocl.in CA26p.478M

συνδημιουργός.definition: fellow-workman, Pl.Lg.671d; Dor. of magistrates in Locris, IG9.335

συνδιαβαίνω.definition: go through or cross over together, Th.6.101, X.An.7.1.4; with one, Plu.Sert.12, Lib.Or.18.67

συνδιαβάλλω.definition: cross together; accuse along with, D.61.12:—Pass., to be accused together, Th.6.61, Lys.12.93, D.39.19

συνδιαβαπτίζομαι.definition: Med., infuse itself into, Procl.in Prm.p.617, cf. p.690 S.: also as v.l. for in D.25.41

συνδιαβιβάζω.definition: causal of carry through or over together, Pl.Lg.892e, X.HG6.2.10; help to convey across, Plu.Luc.4

συνδιαγιγνώσκω.definition: join with one in determining or decreeing, . . , Th.2.64, cf. D.C.43.25; distinguish at the same time, Gal.5.625, UP2.6

συνδιαγνωμονέω.definition: decide in the same sense, Eust.341.7

συνδιάγω.definition: go through together, Hsch.: abs. , live together, Arist.Rh.1381a30; Id.EN1166a7, Dsc.Prooem.4; Arist.EN1157b22; Plu.2.993c

συνδιαζώννυμι.definition: in Pass., to be linked by aspect with a planet, of the moon, Cat.Cod.Astr.8.103.3

συνδιαιρέω.definition: divide together, Plu.2.425b; Med., divide the proceeds of a robbery, PCair. Zen.491 ; but, divide, share a property, PTeb.383.48

συνδιαιτάομαι.definition: Pass., live with or together, Th.2.50; Act. decide as together, Poll.8.129, Them.Or.11.146b

συνδιαίτησις.definition: living together, intercourse, Metrod.Herc.831.13, Ph.2.591, J.AJ1.1.2, Plu.Aem.1, Dio16, etc.; ordinary behaviour towards them, Arr.An.4.7.4

συνδιαιτητής.definition: joint arbitrator, D.33.19, 31; one who lives with another, companion, Luc.Ep.Sat.36 , Sch.Ar.Pl.602

συνδιαιωνίζω.definition: pass all one's life with, Hsch; co-exist perpetually with, Ph.2.216, cf. 419, al

συνδιάκειμαι.definition: Pass., take part with; Medic., = Herod.Med. in Rh.Mus.58.105

συνδιακινδυνεύω.definition: share in danger, Hdt.7.220; Pl.La.189b, IG22.505.32

συνδιακομίζω.definition: fut. assist in bringing over, PHib. 1.54.31 :—Pass., cross over together, Plb.3.43.4, Plu.Brut.37

συνδιακόπτω.definition: cut through together, in Pass., Heliod. ap. Orib.46.7.2, Aët.7.62

συνδιακοσμέω.definition: set in order together, Pl.Lg.712b, cf. Plu.Num.1, Sol.26

συνδιακρίνω.definition: determine together, Ti.Locr.104e; Pass., to be separated, Arist.Xen.977a4

συνδιακυβερνάω.definition: guide or govern jointly, Pl.Plt.304a, Jul.Or.5.18b

συνδιαλαμβάνω.definition: examine together, Ptol.Tetr.8; Plb.16.25.1:—Pass., to be distributed together with, Plot.6.4.4; Herod.Med.in Rh.Mus.58.89

συνδιαλέγομαι.definition: converse with or together, Ath.3.97d, Ach.Tat.6.18, Gloss

συνδιαλλάσσω.definition: Att. help in reconciling; alter together, A.D.Adv.162.1

συνδιαμάχομαι.definition: fight to the end together, Pl.Phlb.66e

συνδιαμένω.definition: stand one's ground with others, X.Cyr.4.5.53, Arist.EE1235b9; to be fixed also, Gal.18.767

συνδιαμνημονεύω.definition: call to remembrance along with, Aeschin.1.18, D.19.19

συνδιανέμω.definition: distribute together with, . . Lib.Decl.45.27:—Pass., c. dat., Plu.2.1024c, 1082b, cf. Gal.2.391

συνδιανεύω.definition: slew or turn together, of war-engines, Plb.1.23.10: c. dat. instr., Plu.2.63b: metaph., Plb.3.38.5

συνδιανήχομαι.definition: swim through together with, Sotion ap.Stob.3.14.10

συνδιαπεραίνω.definition: assist in bringing to an end, Pl.Grg.506b

συνδιαπλέκω.definition: interweave, Herm.in Phdr.p.110A.:—Pass., Iamb. ap. Stob.1.49.31, Phot

συνδιαπολεμέω.definition: carry on a war along with, IG12.108.50: abs., ib.22.732 ; which remained with him throughout the war, Th.8.13

συνδιαπονέω.definition: continue to work together, Pl.Sph.218b; Id.Lg.842e

συνδιαπορέω.definition: start doubts or questions together, Plu.Arist.11; Id.Pomp.75; D.H.11.25; Phld.Rh. 1.91 S., cf. BGU1770.4 , Plu.Caes.32

συνδιαπορθμεύομαι.definition: cross over by ferry together, Procop.Goth.4.20

συνδιαπράσσω.definition: Att. accomplish together; Med., negotiate at the same time, X.An.4.8.24

συνδιαρκέω.definition: last as long as, c. dat., Them.Or.5.68b

συνδιασκοπέω.definition: fut. J.AJ6.6.2: aor. 1 inf. Pl.Prt.349a:—look through or examine along with, Pl.Prt. l.c., 361d:— so in pres. Med., Id.R.458b

συνδιαστέλλω.definition: distinguish at the same time; Pass., to be expanded together, of lungs and chest, Gal.8.325

συνδιαστρέφω.definition: distort together, Id.18.833: metaph., Plu.2.521b:—Pass., Id.Lys.17, Gal. l.c., etc

συνδιασύρω.definition: join in depreciating, prob. cj. in Plu.2.631e

συνδιασῴζω.definition: assist in preserving, Th.4.62, 7.57; SIG529.9 ; D.28.15, cf. Epicur.Fr.217 ; save both my arms and myself together, Pl.Smp.220e

συνδιαταλαιπωρέω.definition: endure hardship with or together, Pl.Cri.45d

συνδιατείνω.definition: help to stretch, Gal.8.288:—Pass., extend all together with, Plu.2.63c

συνδιατελέω.definition: continue with to the end, Pl.Phd.91b, D.61.38, Arist.Phgn.808b19, Iamb.Protr.20

συνδιατηρέω.definition: assist in maintaining, Thphr.CP6.10.6, Plb.2.58.3, SIG569.23 , OGI229.65 , etc

συνδιατίθημι.definition: help in arranging; compose, put together, Porph.Plot.8

συνδιατρέπομαι.definition: Pass., turn away or be ashamed along with, Plu.2.528e

συνδιατρέφω.definition: bring up together with, Ael.NA3.45 codd

συνδιατρίβω.definition: pass or spend time with or together; more freq. without acc., live constantly with, Pl.Smp.172c, Isoc.2.27, cf. Vit.Philonid. p.12 C.; his disciples, X.Mem.1.2.3, 4.1.1

συνδιαττάω.definition: pass through the sieve as well, in Pass., Gal.18.471

συνδιαφαίνομαι.definition: Pass., to be manifest together with, Steph.in Hp.1.107D

συνδιαφέρω.definition: bear along with one; bear to the end along with, help in maintaining, . . Hdt.1.18, cf. 5.79,99; Ar.Eq.597 ; Plu.Brut.13, cf. Jul.Or.8.241c:—Med., Ph.1.323

συνδιαφθείρω.definition: destroy at the same time, Arist.HA585a10, Jul.Or.1.24d; corrupt at the same time, Gal.15.874:—Pass., to be corrupted along with, Isoc.8.41, cf. Din.3.19, Gal.15.697; having his mind destroyed with . . , D.H.3.36: pf. …

συνδιαφυλάσσω.definition: assist in preserving, Lycurg.143; preserve as well, the elegance as well as the numbers, Lib.Or.11.199

συνδιαχειμάζω.definition: spend the winter along with or together, Plu.Ages.40; Id.Ant.37

συνδιδάσκω.definition: produce together with, of a drama, Sch.Ar.Th.1021, cf. Demetr.Lac.Herc.1012.31

συνδίδωμι.definition: contribute, Plu.2.660c; grant, POxy.1130.22 :—Pass., to be allowed also, A.D.Adv.175.14

συνδιεκβάλλω.definition: make to pass through with, Gal.UP9.8

συνδιεκκύπτω.definition: slip out and through together with, Eust.1114.24

συνδιέξειμι.definition: go through together with, X.Mem.4.7.8: so Gal.18.471, Aët.7.1, Hsch

συνδιερευνάομαι.definition: search through together, Lib.Or.17.26, cf. Poll.5.85

συνδιέρχομαι.definition: go together with, belong to a thing, Gal.8.705; gloss on Suid

συνδιηθέομαι.definition: Pass., to be filtered through together, Pl.Ti.66e, Gal.17.836

συνδιημέρευσις.definition: passing one's days together, Plu.Demetr.32, Nic.5

συνδιημερεύω.definition: spend one's days with, X.Smp.4.44, Arist.Rh.1381a30, EN1162b16 ; Gal.7.279; Arist.EN1166b14

συνδιίσταμαι.definition: aor. become separate together with, Procl.Inst.190; differ at the same time, Dam.Pr.143

συνδικάζω.definition: Dor. fut. IG9.32.28 :—have a share in judging, Pl.Lg.768b; of the Lys.30.11, 14; IG l.c.; Lib.Or.12.15

συνδικασία.definition: sine expl., prob. common lawsuit, Poll.8.24

συνδικέω.definition: act as one's advocate, A.Eu.579; to be one of the public advocates , And.1.150, cf. D.20.153; Lex ap.Aeschin.1.47; = Lat. advocatus fisci, D.C.78.13

συνδιοικέω.definition: administer together, Is.7.9, Plb.6.11a.7; Milet.1.203a17 ; with one, D.24.160; bring about together with, . . SIG353.5 :—Med., . . Thphr.Char.21.11 :—Pass., share the advantage of, Sor.1.96

συνδιόλλυμι.definition: kill together, E.Fr.551:—Pass., perish together, Procop.Arc.19

συνδιορθόω.definition: straighten at the same time, set a; correct or improve at the same time, Arist.Top.151b7; prob. in Men.Pk.161; Iamb.VP19.92; Porph.Plot.1

συνδιορίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be determined also, Str.2.3.1 : c. dat., Dam.Pr.36

συνδισκεύω.definition: play at quoits with, Luc.D Deor.14.2

συνδοκέω.definition: seem to one as to another, seem good also; more freq. impers., it seems good also, E.IT71; Ar Av.197; Pl.Prt.331b; . . Id.Hp.Ma.283b: folld. by inf., X.Cyr.1.6.8; . . Pl.Ti.75c

συνδοκιμάζω.definition: examine along with or together; approve, J.AJ20.2.2; Sor.2.15

συνδοξάζω.definition: join in approving; agree with, Plot.1.2.3, Porph. ap.Stob.3.1.123, Marin.Procl.21

συνδουλεύω.definition: to be a fellow-slave, Din.Fr.89.32; with one, E.Hec.204

σύνδουλος.definition: fellow-slave, masc., Id.Ion1109, Ar.Pax745 , Theopomp.Com.32.8, Lys.Fr.331 S., Herod.5.56, Ev.Matt.18.29, etc.; fem., Hdt.2.134, E.Med.65, etc.; also fem. Hdt.1.110, Babr.3.6. 2. metaph. in NT, Ep.Col.1.7, Apoc.6.11, al

συνδράω.definition: do along with or together, help in doing, S.El.498 , cf. 1025, Th.6.64; E.Andr.40; help in bloodshed and murder, Id.Or.406; . . the joint necessity, Id.Andr.337

συνδρομή.definition: tumultuous concourse of people, Cephisod; of things, Lyc.649; a determination of blood, Arist.Pr.889b30; Plu.2.695a; combination, Sor.1.9; Str.5.3.7; its conclusion, moral, AP9.203 ; esp. Medic., concurrence of sympto…

συνδυάζω.definition: —Pass., aor. Arist.GA724b15: pf; Pass., freq. of marriage or sexual intercourse, pair, copulate, Id.Pol.1252a26, etc.; Id.EE1242a24; esp. of animals, X.Cyn.5.6, Arist.HA539b9, al.: c. dat., Pl.Lg.840d, cf. Arist.HA612…

συνδυασμός.definition: a being taken two together; mating, copulation, Hp.Mul.2.146 vulg. , Arist.Pol.1335a11; esp. of animals, Id.HA539b26, al.; ib.539a27; Id.GA720b29; ib.717b14

συνδυναστεύω.definition: rule or have chief power along with, Nic.Dam.Fr.80 J

συνδωρέομαι.definition: present at the same time, Polyaen.8.16.6

συνεγγίζω.definition: draw near, Plb.1.23.8; to a person or thing, Id.3.69.13, D.S.3.72, 17.41; Sor.1.56; Gem.17.28; approximate, Stoic. 1.48; Hipparch.1.10.8, cf. Phld.Rh.1.362 S.; Id.Mus. p.99 K.; abs. , Id.Ir.p.74 W.; in the part of sum…

συνεγγισμός.definition: approach, nearness, of constellations, Str.3.5.9, Ptol.Geog.1.13.1, etc.; Sor.1.66; Arr.Epict.1.4.8

συνεγγράφω.definition: register or enter along with, Plu.2.763e; D.H.6.84; PSI10.1160.4

συνεγγυάω.definition: join in betrothing, Plu.Cat.Mi.25:—Med., join in warranting, Ph.2.60: abs., PHib.1.94.16

συνεγείρω.definition: help in raising, Ps.-Phoc.140; raise also, Ep.Eph.2.6; help in stirring up, Plu.2.117c:—Pass., rise together, LXXIs.14.9, Ep.Col.2.12, etc.; of an invalid, revive, Aristid.Or.48.43

συνεγκαίω.definition: aor. help to brand, IG11.287 A 58

συνεγκηδεύω.definition: bury as well, prob. rest. in CIG 4303h6

συνεγκλίνω.definition: in Pass., collapse completely; Act., write as an enclitic, Sch.Th.1.11: hence enclitic, Hdn.Gr.1.551, cf. AB1142

συνεδρεύω.definition: hold a council, consult, deliberate, D.10.6, Plb.2.26.4, Onos.3.1; consult with, sit in council with, Plb.3.68.15; PSI10.1100.2 ; Jul.Or.4.135d; to be present at, take part in a discussion, Arist.Metaph.987a2

συνέδριον.definition: place of meeting, council-chamber, Hdt.8.79, X.HG2.4.23, POxy.717.8 ; in court, Lys.9.6; Plb.2.39.1

συνεθέλω.definition: have the same wish, consent, Antipho3.2.8, X.Eq.Mag.9.7; to a thing, Aen.Tact.11.13; poet. S.OC1344, Fr.489, E.HF832, also in Arist.EN1167a1: fut. E.Tr.62

συνειδοποιέομαι.definition: Pass., to be specified together with, Dam.Pr.102

συνείκω.definition: give way, yield, Plb.32.13.3, cf. 5.71.10; of things, Anon. ap. Suid., cf. D.S.2.8, Dsc.5.74, Sor.2.63 , Fract.6

συνειλέω.definition: crowd together, Hdt.3.45; also of things, bind together, Id.4.67:—Pass., to be crowded or pressed together, into less compass, X.HG7.2.8; J.BJ5.3.1: abs., Plu.Alex.60 ; compressed, Thphr.CP3.14.8; Aret.SD1.7; Luc.Vit.…

συνείλησις.definition: rolling oneself up, of a hedgehog, Ael.NA6.64; rolling up, Sch.Arat.156; synthesis, Iamb.Comm.Math.12

συνείρω.definition: Aeol. aor. part. fem. dub. in; in speaking, freq. in a disparaging sense, D.18.308; Arist.EN1147a21, cf.Phld.Rh.1.247 S.; in a breath, Plb.10. 47.9; Luc.Tim.9, cf. Nigr.8, Bacch.7; also simply of a continuous speech, …

συνεισάγω.definition: bring in together, X.Cyr.3.2.24; PEleph.26.6 ; Plu.2.91b, cf.Placit.1.27.3, Hierocl.in CA6p.428M., 22p.468M.:—Med., BGU1760.28 :— Pass., in which is included . . , S.E.P.2.86, cf. Steph.in Hp.1.107D

συνείσακτος.definition: introduced together: Lat. synisactas; illegitimate, Eust.1954.8

συνεισβαίνω.definition: embark in together with, . . A.Th.602; E.Med.477; Antipho5.82

συνεισβάλλω.definition: intr., make an inroad into a country; enter together, J.BJ3.7.31; appear together with, of symptoms, Gal.17.390, cf. 17.503; of bodily constitution, Id.10.234; of states of the weather, Id.17.24

συνεισδίδωμι.definition: submit to a court together with another, Mitteis Chr.31 ii 11

συνείσειμι.definition: go in or enter together, Id.Resp.472a9, Col.794a26; Athenio1.45

συνεισέρχομαι.definition: enter along with or together, E.Hel.327; ib.1083; Th.4.57; And.4.17; Mitteis Chr.91 ii 26 ; of things, S.E.P.1.10, Gal.UP8.7, Lib.Or.64.12, etc

συνεισκατοικέω.definition: settle in together, dub.l. in Hp.Ep.23

συνεισκρίνομαι.definition: Pass., to be introduced with or together, Placit.4.17.2; of chemical reactions, Ps.-Democr. Alch.p.43 B

συνεισπηδάω.definition: leap into with, c. dat., App.Mith.98

συνεισπίπτω.definition: rush in along with or together, X.An.5.7.25; esp. of soldiers pursuing the besieged to their own gates and getting in with them, Hdt.3.55, cf.78,9.102, Th.6.100, X.HG7.2.7, etc.; Ar.Ec.1095; X.An.7.1.18; Id.HG4.7.6: a…

συνεισπλέω.definition: sail into together, X.HG1.6.16: abs., Eun.VSp.485 B

συνεισποιέω.definition: admit to a share in, Plu.2.482e, 484d

συνεισπράσσω.definition: Att. help one in exacting money from another , D.49.69, cf. IG22.111.14, SIG1215.9 ; D.H.10.11

συνεισφορά.definition: joint contribution, Poll.8.157, Arch.Pap.6.219 , OGI 609.17 , CIG4422 , Asp.in EN73.22

συνείσφορος.definition: liable for payment of contributions or taxes, . . Sammelb.7337.26 ; PFlor.18.25 , cf. Sammelb.4284.11

συνεκβαίνω.definition: go out together, X.An.4.3.22, cf. Str.15.2.13

συνεκβοηθέω.definition: join in going out to aid one, D.S.25.10

συνεκβόσκομαι.definition: absorb, suck up as well, Gal.12.29

συνεκβράσσω.definition: of the sea, throw on shore along with, Lyc.898:—Pass., to be ejected, Hsch

συνεκδέχομαι.definition: take on oneself a share of; supply in thought a word or phrase in connexion, Corn.ND17,30, S.E.P.1.200,202

συνεκδημέω.definition: Dor. IG12.868 A 7 :—go or be abroad with another, Ephor.96 J., PCair.Zen. 396.2 , Plu.Cat.Mi.5

συνεκδιαφορέομαι.definition: Pass., to be dispersed also, Olymp.in Mete.281.15

συνεκδίδωμι.definition: join in giving out; help a poor man in portioning out his daughter , Lys.19.59, D.18.268:—Med., PEnteux.91.2 , D.H.2.10

συνεκδοχή.definition: understanding one thing with another: hence in Rhet., synecdoche, an indirect mode of expression, when the whole is put for a part or vice versa, Quint.Inst.8.6.19, Aristid.Quint.2.9, Ps.-Plu.Vit.Hom.22

συνεκδρομή.definition: running out together: metaph., following the same rule, analogy, A.D.Adv.142.9, Synt.49.14, Simp.in Ph.274.25, Eust.341.22, EM66.52

συνεκδύομαι.definition: Med., put off together; Pass., go out together, Polyaen.2.31.2

συνεκθειάζω.definition: join in placing among the gods, Plu.2.492d

συνεκθερμαίνω.definition: make hot like oneself, Id.Pomp.8, Gal.7.387:—Pass., Hp.Vict.2.66

συνεκθηλύνω.definition: help to make womanish, Clearch.4, J.BJ7.8.7

συνεκθλίβω.definition: squeeze out together, Arist.Pr.876b1 : Gramm. , Sch.Heph.p.106C

συνεκκαίω.definition: set on fire together, Ael.VH13.1; Plu.Alex.35; Gal.11.406: abs., help to flare up, Thphr.Ign.27,37: metaph., help to inflame, Plb.3.14.3; Plu.Pel.19, Caes.44

συνεκκαλέομαι.definition: Med., call out or excite together, Plb.18.19.11, cf. 11.1a.2; Plu.2.917c; Thphr.Sud.16

συνέκκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be exposed with a child, Men.Epit.136,233, Hld.2.31, Longus4.18

συνεκκεντέω.definition: pierce or stab at once, LXX2 Ma.5.26

συνεκκλέπτω.definition: help to steal away, E.Tr.1018, Hel.1370; help in concealing it, Id.El.364

συνεκκλησιάζω.definition: share in membership of the IG9.32.13 , Plu.Sol.18: hence Poll.6.157

συνεκκλύζω.definition: wash out together, Arist.Col.795b6:—Pass., Id.GA727b16, Dsc.2.101

συνεκκομίζω.definition: help to carry away; attend the funeral of, Phylarch.26 J., Plu.CG14:—Pass., Mitt.Ver.Klass.Philol.in Wien10.122

συνεκκρίνω.definition: help in clearing out by secretion, Arist.GA737b35:—Pass., to be got rid of by secretion also, ib.727a17; with the perspiration, Id.Mete.357b4, cf. 370b15 , Plu.Crass.33, Gal.18.40, al

συνεκκρούομαι.definition: to be driven from one's purpose with, Plu.Caes.33; Vett. Val.238.33 cod. V

συνεκλαμβάνω.definition: take out together with; farm taxes with, UPZ114.16

συνεκλεαίνω.definition: pound together, Dsc.Alex.4, Damocr. ap. Gal.13.1056, Philum. ap. Orib.45.29.71

συνεκλέγομαι.definition: Med., choose, select, Gal.11.362; contract an illness, Luc.Ep.Sat.28

συνεκλείπω.definition: vanish with or also, Str.10.2.12, Plu.2.415f, 777a, al., Gal.12.412; . . ended with his life, Plu.Comp.Lyc.Num.4

συνεκλύω.definition: help to relax, enfeeble, Onos.10.11; Sor.1.46:—Pass., to be relaxed along with, c. dat., ib.25; Plu.2.596a; AP6.56 ; of language, lose its force with, Longin.39.4

συνεκμαλάσσω.definition: soften completely, Damocr. ap. Gal.14.200, Dsc.1.66

συνεκμαχέω.definition: march out to fight together, Ar.Lys.1154

συνεκπέμπω.definition: send out or forth together; of things, send forth or eject together, Pl.Ti.91a; Anon. ap.Suid. s.v

συνεκπηδάω.definition: run out together, PTeb.15.4 ; spring out along with, Philostr.Her.19.5

συνεκπικραίνομαι.definition: Pass., to be much provoked also, Plu.2.468b

συνεκπίπτω.definition: fall out or be ejected together; c. dat., rush out together with, Plu.Pel.32, Lys.28; to be carried away by, Id.Per.20, cf. Plb.27.9.9

συνεκπλέω.definition: Ion. fut. inf. Lys.13.25:—sail out along with, c. dat., Hdt.1.5, etc.; Lys.13.27: abs., ib.25, Th.4.3: or name of a Comedy by Philippides

συνεκπληρόω.definition: fill up the measure of, complete, Plb.16.28.2; Id.14.4.3; indulge to the full, Id.3.78.5

συνεκπλήσσω.definition: Att. combine to carry away , Plu.2.41c

συνεκπνέω.definition: breathe one's last along with, E.IT684, cf. PHerc. 1041.3; Luc.Laps.3

συνεκποιέω.definition: suffice, IG22.968.43 :—Pass., to be sufficiently supplied by, Plb.6.49.7; cf. III

συνεκπολεμόω.definition: excite to war together, Anon. ap. Suid. s.v. become hostile together, Plu.2.380b

συνεκπονέω.definition: help in working out; without acc., join in labour with, assist to the utmost, Id.Ion850, Fr.136; perh. sharing the leg-work, i.e. helping me to walk, Id.Ion740

συνεκπορεύομαι.definition: Pass., go forth together with, LXXJd.13.25: abs., Plb.6.32.5

συνεκπορέω.definition: help to provide, Ecphant. ap. Stob.4.7.64

συνεκπορίζω.definition: help in procuring or supplying, X.An.5.8.25; Plu.2.73e; Hierocl.in CA11p.444M

συνεκπράσσομαι.definition: Ion. Med., assist in avenging, . . Hdt.7.169; cf. III

συνεκπυρόω.definition: inflame together, in Pass., Pl.Ti.65e, Diocl.Fr.147, Gal.7.278

συνεκτάσσω.definition: Att. arrange in line with, X.Cyr.6.3.18

συνεκτείνω.definition: prostrate beside; trans., extend together with, Ph.2.23, cf. Zos.4.33; . . Lib.Or.38.18

συνεκτελέω.definition: help in completing, Aristid.1.442 J.; help in ripening, Thphr.CP1.13.9

συνεκτίθημι.definition: put on shore along with, c. dat., Plu.2.27c; carry themselves off also, S.E.M.8.480:—Med., expose together with, Hld.4.8, al.:—Pass. in same sense, Men.Epit.59

συνεκτίκτω.definition: bring forth together, produce food simultaneously with the young, as oviparous animals do, Arist.GA774b30, cf. Pol.1256b10, cj. in Pl.Tht.156b

συνεκτίνω.definition: fut. pay along with or together, help in paying, Id.Lg.855b, D.53.26, Plu.Rom.13

συνεκτραχηλίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be thrown as by a horse, Plu.2.802d

συνεκτραχύνομαι.definition: Pass., to be furious together, of torrents, Id.Sull.16

συνεκτρέπομαι.definition: Pass., vary with, c. dat., Ptol.Tetr.3 : abs., vary together, Gal.6.384

συνεκτρέφω.definition: rear up along with or together, Pl.Smp.209c; assist in bringing them up, Id.Mx.249a: metaph., Plu.Brut.31:—Pass., grow up with, E.IT709, cf. And.1.48, Luc.Am.32

συνεκφαίνω.definition: show forth or display together, App.BC1.39; signify together, Plu.2.33d, cf. Gal.16.725:—Pass., Ar.Did.Epit.28

συνεκφλογόομαι.definition: Pass., to be burnt together, Olymp.in Mete.333.13

συνεκφύομαι.definition: Pass. with aor. 2 Act., to be born together, Philostr.Im.2.27; have its origin with, Gal.18.941, Ruf.Anat.38

συνεκφωνέω.definition: exclaim at the same time, Ach.Tat.1.12:—Pass., to be uttered together, D.T.639.14, Longin.38.3, S.E.M.1.102

συνεκχέω.definition: pour out together, Aret.SD2.13; AP7.608 :—Pass., stream out together, D.S.3.29: metaph. of men, Plb.9.9.7, 11.14.7; Eun.VSp.465 B. in Pass., have the juice squeezed out with, . . Dieuch. ap.Orib.4.7.17

συνελεουρέω.definition: to be joint-curator of marsh-pastures, Rev.Phil.60 .294

συνελευθερόω.definition: join in freeing from; abs.,join in freeing, Hdt.7.157, cf. 51, Th.2.72, 6.56

συνελίσσω.definition: Ion. (as also in E.Ion1164; roll up with, PGiss.25.7 ; POxy.113.5

συνέλκω.definition: aor. draw together; metaph., . . drawn into association with the man by his friendship with you, UPZ146.4, cf. 31 ; dub. sens. in POxy.1188.9

συνελπίζω.definition: join in hope, Phot. and Suid. s.v

συνεμβαίνω.definition: fut. PTeb.729.3 :—embark together, with one, Luc.Nav.15; Pap. in Glotta 2.150; BGU1817.12 : metaph., embark with one upon naval power, Plb.1.20.7; Id.29.3.8; Id.16.26.6; Supp.Epigr.7.62.9 ; GDI5183.18 ; engage in them…

συνεμβάλλω.definition: help in applying, Ar.Lys.246; put in together with, PMag.Par.1.754, cf. Dsc.1.52, Plu.2.380e, PHolm.7.40:— Pass., Agatharch.28, Herod.Med. ap. Orib.6.20.5

συνεμβιβάζω.definition: causal of put on board together, prob. in D.S.20.68

συνεμβλητέος.definition: to be thrown in together, Herod.Med. ap. Aët.9.37

συνεμπίπρημι.definition: burn together, E.Rh.489, Nic.Dam.Fr.68 J.:—Pass., Str.14.1.22, cf. 15.1.68, Ar.Did.Epit.12

συνεμπίπτω.definition: fall or be put in also; fall on or attack together, Plu.Brut.42 ; of diseases, Hp.Acut.42, Gal.16.493, Aret.SA2.6 codd

συνεμπλέκω.definition: implicate also, J.BJ7.11.2; Plu.2.71f:—Pass., is also involved in . . , Mitteis Chr.89.32

συνέμπορος.definition: metaph., A.Ch.733: c.gen.rei, partner in . . , Ar.Ra.398 ; partner with him for gain, AP9.415

συνέμπτωσις.definition: formal coincidence; in Gramm., similarity of form, A.D.Pron.52.5, al.; Id.Adv.155.13

συνεμφαίνω.definition: indicate at the same time or incidentally, Thphr.HP3.8.1, Demetr.Lac.Herc.1012.37, Gal.15.795, Ath.14.663c, Iamb.Comm.Math.8; . . D.S.3.3:—Pass., appear together, Thphr.HP1.12.2; to be indicated at the same time, Chry…

συνέμφασις.definition: joint or secondary indication, of a thing, S.E.M.7.239, Ath.7.325b

συνεμφύρομαι.definition: Pass., to be plunged in, Vett.Val.330.16

συνενδείκνυμι.definition: indicate together, Gal.10.626:—Med. and Pass., c. dat., Id.6.647, 648, 15.464, al

συνενδεκατίζω.definition: f.l. for in D.58.40, according to Harp.; cf

συνενδίδωμι.definition: give way also, Str.1.3.5, Plu.Caes.31; give way, D.S.17.43; Plu.Per.15

συνενδύομαι.definition: Med. with aor. 2 put on, Arr.An.1.25.2

συνενείκομαι.definition: Ep. for strike or dash against, Hes.Sc.440

συνένειμι.definition: to be all in together, POxy.929.12

συνενεργέω.definition: to be active at the same time, Plot.3.4.6, Ascl.in Metaph.282.5

συνενθάπτω.definition: in Pass., to be buried together, TAM2.599.4

συνενθουσιάζω.definition: to be inspired and rave together, of the Bacchae, D.S.4.3

συνενθουσιάω.definition: = foreg., Plb.38.12.7; Str.3.2.9, etc.; with a person, Plu.Cor.17; or at a thing, Longin.13.2; to be inspired with admiration for, c.dat., Eun.Hist.p.215 D

συνενόω.definition: unite, Ar.Byz.Epit.38.12, Damocr. ap. Gal.13.800, Zos.Alch.p.142 B., Phlp.in GA20.33:—Pass., pf. or to be united, c. dat., J.BJ5.4.3, S.E.M.9.130, PStrassb.31.11 , etc.; Gramm.,form a compound with, A.D.Synt.314.1

συνέντασις.definition: a putting on the stretch, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.233, Plu.2.589a. Placit.4.15.3, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.27.11, Gal.6.171

συνεντείνω.definition: put on the stretch together, Sor.1.70b; Gal.6.173:—Med., exert oneself also, Sor.1.73:—Pass., to be on the stretch together, Muson.Fr.11p.58H., cf. Stoic.2.234, Gal.6.177, v.l. for in Placit.4.13.11

συνεξάγω.definition: lead out together, Hdt.5.75; carry off together, assist in removing, Arist.Pr.868b7; Thphr.CP4.13.5; Plu.2.787e; of suicide, App.BC4.23

συνεξαιθερόω.definition: change into air together, v.l. in Lyd.Mens.4.40

συνεξαιθριάζω.definition: put into the open air together, Dsc.3.146

συνεξαιρέω.definition: take out together, help in removing; Act., help in taking, Id.HG7.4.12, cf. Th.2.29 ; Aeschin.2.32, cf. IG22.127.45; E.Ion61; Id.Tr.24; Isoc.9.18

συνεξαίρω.definition: assist in raising, Str.3.5.7; metaph., help in calling forth the echo, Philostr.Im.1.18; Hld.7.15; Plu.2.819f; help to excite, Luc.Dom.4; excited with the rest by . . , D.S.17.72

συνεξακολουθέω.definition: follow constantly, attend everywhere; of events, turn out in accordance with, OGI763.48 ; Plb.18.32.12; their consequences, Id.3.55.3

συνεξακοντίζομαι.definition: Pass., spurt out along with, Id.1108.3

συνεξαλείφω.definition: abolish also, in Pass., Plu.Cat.Mi.17, Gal.11.10

συνεξαλλοιόω.definition: in Pass., change at the same time, Gal.17 .42, Simp.in Ph.320.22

συνεξαμαρτάνω.definition: err along with, share in a fault, Th.3.43, Lys.3.12, etc.; with them, Isoc.6.19, D.61.19, Chrysipp. Stoic.2.38, etc.; Antipho5.76; Plb.5.11.1

συνεξαμείβω.definition: exchange at the same time, Babr.59.15

συνεξαμιλλάομαι.definition: struggle jointly with, c. dat., Plu.2.137d

συνεξαναλίσκομαι.definition: Pass., to be exhausted together with, D.H.4.23

συνεξαναπληρόω.definition: fill up again with or together, Hp.Anat.1

συνεξανθέω.definition: blossom or break out together, Plu.2.434b

συνεξανίεμαι.definition: Pass., to be relaxed together with, Sor.1.25

συνεξανίστημι.definition: stir up or excite together, Plu.2.44c; Pass., with aor. 2 and pf.Act., rise and come forth with, Id.Ages.12; to be roused to action or ready for action with or together, Id.Pyrrh.11; Id.Dem.18, Cat. Mi.59; Plb.16.9.4

συνεξανοίγω.definition: help one to open a way, c. dat., v.l. in J.BJ5.2.2

συνεξαπατάω.definition: deceive together or also, D.23.159:—Pass., Id.16.2, Str.14.1.24; name of a play by Bato

συνεξαποστέλλω.definition: send forth together, Plb.8.19.6, D.S.14.20:—Pass., fut. go out with, Plb.22.14.11

συνεξάπτω.definition: set on fire, Plu.2.433d, 929c; Hld.7.9; Procl.Inst.129:—Pass., M.Ant.9.9

συνεξαριθμέω.definition: reckon in or besides, Inscr.Délos 372 A 107 :—Pass., D.S.15.53, J.BJ3.4.2

συνεξατμίζω.definition: cause to evaporate together; intr., evaporate, Id.GA752a35, 783a17, PA650b18

συνεξατονέω.definition: lose tension or vigour together with, Plu.2.528e

συνεξεγείρομαι.definition: Pass., to be roused together, Plb.4.47.3

συνεξελαύνω.definition: drive out along with or together, A.Ag.1606; AP9.715

συνεξελεύθερος.definition: fellow-freedman, BGU1141.20 . PSI5.473.2 , IG3.1434, D.C.60.15: fem. Perdrizet Mélanges d' arch. et d' hist.25.82

συνεξελίττομαι.definition: Pass., to be unrolled together, . . follows all the curls, Callistr.Stat.11

συνεξέλκομαι.definition: Pass., to be formed by derivation, A.D.Pron.92.2

συνεξερεύθω.definition: inflame together, only in 3sg. aor. opt. Pass. Hp.Prog.23 , Coac.359

συνεξερευνάω.definition: examine thoroughly with, in aor. Med., Pl.Tht.155e

συνεξέρχομαι.definition: go or come out with, c. dat., Hdt.5.74; of things, Hp.Nat.Hom.14, Arist.HA587a17, GA783a36, Gal.18.135

συνεξετάζω.definition: search out and examine along with or together, Pl.Lg.900d, Ph.2.197, Iamb.Comm. Math.14:—Pass., to be reckoned with or among, or his party or adherents, D.21.127, 190, cf. Luc.Pr. Im.15; but also measure oneself with …

συνεξευπορέω.definition: or f.l. for in X.An.5.8.25: fut. inf. Iamb.Comm.Math.34: aor. inf. Procl.in R.2.96 K

συνεξευρίσκω.definition: assist in finding out, Ar.Th.601; Isoc.4.47; join him in finding out, D.H.3.70; . . E.Heracl.420; Jul.Or.3.114b

συνεξηγέομαι.definition: indicate, explain at the same time, A.D.Pron.37.18, Synt.73.19, Gal.17.596

συνεξημερόομαι.definition: Pass., to be civilized together, Plu.Num.16

συνεξικμάζω.definition: exude or throw off together, ib.883b28, cf. Thphr.Sud.13

συνεξίσταμαι.definition: Pass., make common cause with, Plb.3.34.9, 3.68.8, 5.39.4

συνεξισχύω.definition: to be strong enough to, c. inf., Olymp.in Mete.31.21

συνεξοδεύω.definition: go out along with, Satyr.3; to be carried in a procession , OGI90.42

συνεξοκέλλω.definition: intr., run aground together, c. dat., App.BC5.121: metaph., Plu.2.985c

συνεξολισθάνω.definition: slip out along with, Man.5.43, in aor

συνεξόμνυμι.definition: in Med., swear jointly in the negative, GDI4986.18

συνεξομοιόω.definition: assimilate, make similar, Plu.2.1054b; ib.97a; Gal.UP14.7; suit, accommodate, . . Herm.in Phdr.p.76 A.:—Pass., to become or be like, Thphr.CP1.9.3, Fr.173, Plb.31.18.4, Placit.1.6.1; Vett.Val.304.27; Sor.1.88; become …

συνεξορμάω.definition: help to urge on, Isoc.10.52; intr., rush forth or sally out together, X.Cyr.1.4.20 , 7.1.29, Hell.Oxy.15.3, Plb.10.37.6; shoots up along with the corn, X.Oec.17.12,14:—Pass., D.C.41.9

συνεξουρέω.definition: discharge with the urine, Hp.Aph.4.77, Gal.8.84

συνεξωθέω.definition: drive out together, Hp.Vict.2.66; puff out, Plu.2.820a; ib.984f; ib.1110e; Str.4.6.6; dismiss at the same time, Lib.Or.18.131

συνεορτάζω.definition: join in keeping festival, D.S.4.4, CIG2820.19 , POxy.1025.12 ; with us, Plu.2.666d, cf. Arr.Epict.4.1.104; SIG798.12 ; D.C.59.8; Them.Or.14.181a

συνεπαγωνίζομαι.definition: join in stirring up a contest besides, besides all that had happened, Plb.3.118.6

συνεπαινέω.definition: approve together, give joint assent; join in praising, X.Eq.Mag.5.14codd., Pl.Mx.246a:— Pass., Arist.Rh.1415b28

συνέπαινος.definition: joining in approbation of a thing, or give one's consent to a thing, Hdt.3.119, 5.31: abs., ib.20, Nic.Dam.Fr.130.18 J.: c. acc. et inf., consent that . . , Hdt.7.15: c. dat. pers., D.C.57.15

συνεπαιτιάομαι.definition: accuse also of a thing, Th.1.135; Plu.Per.10: abs., Id.Them.23

συνεπακολουθέω.definition: follow closely, accompany, Pl.Phd.81e, Plu.Alex.41; Str.8.6.22; I Nilus have been present too , PFay.43.4 , cf. PLond.2.256.3 ; of things, Hp.Oss.4, Ocell.2.22, Sor.1.31, etc

συνεπαλαλάζω.definition: join in raising the war-cry, J.BJ4.5.1

συνεπαμύνω.definition: join in repelling, Th.6.56; join in assisting, App.BC3.32

συνεπανίσταμαι.definition: Pass., with aor. 2 Act., join in a revolt or rebellion, Hdt.3.84, Th.1.132, OGI218.118 ; with one, Hdt.3.61; Id.1.59; against them with you, D.H.6.74

συνεπανορθόω.definition: aor. D.10.34:—join in re-establishing, l.c., Plb.30.20.4

συνεπασκέω.definition: join in training, making efficient, Aristid.1.452 J

συνεπαύξω.definition: help to increase, IG12.129.58 , cf. SIG695.75 , 601.23 , Gal.UP4.7, al., D.C.39.25

συνεπεισφέρω.definition: bring in as well, Vett. Val.359.14, Syrian.in Metaph.90.36:—Med., help to bring in, X.HG6.5.43

συνεπεκτείνω.definition: extend or spread over together, Aristaenet.2.15:—Pass., Arist.Ph.216b29, Gal.UP14.14; expand with, Id.2.562; extend or project against the enemy as well, Ael.Tact.13.3

συνεπελαφρίζω.definition: in Pass., to be made light with something, Ph.2.513: metaph., to be relieved with, Orib.8.30.1

συνεπελαφρύνω.definition: help to make light, i.e. assist in bearing, Hdt.1.18

συνεπεμβαίνω.definition: mount upon together; join in trampling on him, Aristid.1.471 J

συνεπευθύνω.definition: help to direct or guide, Plu.Rom.7

συνεπευφημέω.definition: join in cheering or applauding, D.S.1.72, 17.72

συνεπεύχομαι.definition: join in prayer, Th.6.32; pray also to, Plu.2.708c: c. acc. et inf., profess also that . . , Ar.Th.951: c. inf. fut., make a vow also to . . , X.An.3.2.9

συνεπηχέω.definition: join in singing, join in a chorus; re-echo, Luc.Dom.3, cf. J.AJ12.9.4, D.C.66.22

συνεπιβαίνω.definition: mount together, Arist.HA591b21; enter upon or undertake along with, Antipho2.2.13

συνεπιβλάπτομαι.definition: Pass., to be damaged together with, Arist.Pol.1270b15

συνεπιβλέπω.definition: regard at the same time, Antip.Stoic.3.256; consider as well, Gal.9.498

συνεπιβοηθέω.definition: come to aid together, Plb.4.69.4, Gal.8.16, Pall.in Hp.2.116,128 D

συνεπιβουλεύω.definition: join in plotting, X.HG5.4.22, D.S.5.50, etc.; Is.6.55, D.H.3.29, etc

συνεπιγίγνομαι.definition: come on together, of troops, Plb.10.38.10; of fevers, D.S.32.10; occur as well, Vett.Val.222.34

συνεπιγράφω.definition: inscribe together with other writing, PMag.Lond.121.421; indicate as joint author, Plu.2.816e; Gal.11.202:—Pass., to be named jointly as auctor of a decree of the Senate, Notiz.Arch.4.21.75 ; named jointly with me as …

συνεπιδημέω.definition: travel to a place together, Str.15.1.2; the plagues having visited them with the ark, J.AJ6.1.2

συνεπιδίδωμι.definition: give up wholly or willingly; join in presenting an application, PAmh.2.85.24 , Sammelb.7363.25 , etc

συνεπιζεύγνυμαι.definition: Pass., to be closely connected with, Phld.Ir.p.66W

συνεπιθειάζω.definition: ascribe to divine interposition, Plu.Sull.6; recognize it as divine, Id.2.409c

συνεπιθεωρέω.definition: contemplate at the same time, S.E.M.7.46

συνεπιθήγω.definition: help to sharpen or stimulate, Plu.2.433d

συνεπιθλίβω.definition: exert pressure at the same time, Gal.8.15

συνεπιθρηνέω.definition: join in bewailing, ib.56a, M.Ant.7.43; Plu.2.541a

συνεπιθυμητής.definition: one of the same desires, Pl.Clit.408c

συνεπιθωΰσσω.definition: halloo so as to cheer on together, Plu.2.757d

συνεπίκειμαι.definition: Pass., join in attacking, Ar.Eq.266; weigh upon, Phld.Rh.2.139S

συνεπικελεύω.definition: encourage by consent, PLond.3.1204.17 , PStrassb.84.19 , PGrenf.2.26.24

συνεπικιρνάω.definition: mix with besides; break or bow down at once, metaph., Plu.Phil.9

συνεπικλίνω.definition: incline at the same time, Gal.6.151 , Dam.Pr.168

συνεπικοσμέω.definition: help to adorn, X.Hier.8.6; Arist.Top.157a11; Id.EN1100b26, cf. Phld.Mus.p.39K.:—Pass., prob. in OGI470.23

συνεπικουρέω.definition: help to succour, X.Hier.3.2; Id.Cyr.1.6.24; Astrol., join as ally, S.E.M.5.32

συνεπικουφίζω.definition: lighten at the same time, Plu.Cam.25; help in relieving, Ph.2.364; raise aloft, metaph., Plu.Eum.9

συνεπικραδαίνω.definition: move backwards and forwards together with, of dogs near game, X.Cyn.6.16

συνεπικρίνω.definition: help to judge between; help to decide a matter, Plu.2.53b, Longin.1.2, Plot.2.1.6

συνεπικρύπτω.definition: help to conceal, Id.Alc.28, Tim.10:—Med., Iamb.VP34.245

συνεπιλαμβάνω.definition: take part with a person; envelop also, Id.2.301, cf. 18.937

συνεπιλάμπω.definition: illumine at the same time, Thphr.CP4.4.13, Plot.4.3.17

συνεπιλύομαι.definition: perh. join in cancelling a mortgage, Delph.3.233

συνεπιμαρτυρέω.definition: join in attesting, Arist.Mu.400a15; Astrol., to be also configurate, of planets, Nech. ap. Vett.Val.279.3, Cat.Cod.Astr.2.187

συνεπιμείγνυμι.definition: join, unite, Aristaenet.1.10:— Pass., of veins, muscles, etc., Gal.2.816, UP7.11

συνεπιμελέομαι.definition: or join in taking care of or attending to, Th.8.39, X.Eq.Mag.1.8, etc.; have joint charge of, Id.An.6.1.22; D.48.5, cf. Arist.Ath.49.3; IG12.59.14, cf. 88.19; . . 1917.41 : abs., X.Mem.2.8.3; Pl.Lg.754c; IG12.39.68; P…

συνεπιμερίζω.definition: assign at once, at the same time; contribute also , Vett.Val.178.25

συνεπινεύω.definition: join in assenting, Arist.SE169a33, IPE2.52; c. acc., join in granting, IGRom.4.1302.20

συνεπινήχομαι.definition: float on the surface together, Aristaenet.1.3

συνεπινοέω.definition: join in contriving, S.E.M.8.161; Pass., to be included in the idea of a thing, c. dat., Phld.Vit.p.38J., Dam.Pr.57: abs., to be taken into consideration or understood as well, Gal.6.105, 11.5, 17.707

συνεπιπλέω.definition: join in a naval expedition, D.50.59

συνεπιπλοκή.definition: association, Ptol.Tetr.111,181; of planets, Nech. ap. Vett.Val.279.6

συνεπιρρέω.definition: flow to together, Gal.13.668, PGrenf.2.69.19 ; D.H.10.16; extend in flow, Plu.2.696d

συνεπιρρώννυμι.definition: help to strengthen or support, Plu.Alex.33, cf. Brut.49:—Pass., of language, to be based firmly at the same time on, Longin.11.2

συνεπισημαίνω.definition: help to indicate; Med., explain: or interpret in addition, Gal.17.600

συνεπισκέπω.definition: protect at the same time, Ascl.Tact.1.3

συνεπισκευάζω.definition: join in repairing. OGI483.33 (Pergam; Med., work up in addition, Procl.Par. Ptol.14

συνεπισκοπέω.definition: fut. Pl.Cra.422c: aor. : non-Att. pres. Gal.6.827, 10.215, Ptol.Phas. Prooem.8, Alex.Aphr.in Sens.5.16: pres. Med. and Pass

συνεπισκοποῦμαι.definition: Gal.6.256, 10.662, 2.681:—join in examining, examine or consider together with, Pl.Hp.Ma.296b; Id.Cra.422c; Arist.MM1200b22; Str.8.3.23; Plu.2.83e, cf. 714c; . . Pl.Ap.27a

συνεπισκυθρωπάζω.definition: look sternly at with or together, Plu.2.672e

συνεπισπάω.definition: draw on together; mostly in Med., draw on along with one, esp. to ruin, Pl.R.451a, cf. D.19.224, IPE12.352.23 ; of things, involve, bring on, Phld.Ir.p.23W., cf. p.77W.; also without any bad sense, Pl.Ti.44a, X.Cyr.2.…

συνεπίσταμαι.definition: know perfectly well or fully, . . Pl.Lg.821c; Arist.SE177a27

συνεπιστατέω.definition: act as a joint supervisor, Pl.R.528c; IG12.92.39 ; will jointly supervise all these works, PCair.Zen.34.22, cf. 574.5

συνεπιστέλλω.definition: authorize at the same time, BGU1741.8 , POxy.1024.6 ; send with or together, Luc.Sat.15

συνεπιστενάζω.definition: groan at or over together, Epict.Ench.16; Diog.Oen.61

συνεπιστρατεύω.definition: join in making war, Th.5.48, D.5.16, etc

συνεπιστρέφω.definition: turn at the same time; help to make attentive, Plu.Num.14; turn towards them also, Id.2.542c, etc

συνεπισυκοφαντέω.definition: join in misrepresenting, cavilling at, dub. l. in Id.2.1096e

συνεπισύρομαι.definition: Med., draw to oneself together, Archig. ap. Aët.12.1; draw with oneself, Gal.UP8.7

συνεπισφραγίζω.definition: seal or approve together, in Med., PRev.Laws 42.19, 84.2

συνεπιτείνω.definition: help to strain or intensify; intr., agree in intensity with, Arist.Insomn.460b13, v.l. in Plu.2.451d

συνεπιτελέω.definition: fut. BGU 237.14 :—help; join in performing, X.Ages.2.17

συνεπιτέλλω.definition: rise together with, Autol.2.11, Gem.17.26, Adam.Vent.42

συνεπιτίθημι.definition: help in putting on, put on still more; Med., join in attacking, Th.3.54, cf.6.17; Phld.Vit.p.21J.; Th.1.23, 6.10, Pl.Phlb.16a: abs., X.Cyr.4.2.3, Is.6.29, Arist.Pol.1311b17, LXXDe.32.27, Act.Ap.24.9

συνεπιτρέπω.definition: join in permitting, Epist. ap. J.AJ16.6.7

συνεπιτρίβω.definition: destroy at once or utterly, X.An.5.8.20

συνεπιτροπεύω.definition: act as joint guardian over, Olymp.in Alc.p.60C., cf.IPE2.52,53 , POxy.265.29

συνεπιτροχάζομαι.definition: Pass., to be hurried along with, Eust.1719.14

συνεπιφαίνω.definition: make perceptible at the same time, Thphr.Od.10:— Pass., appear together, Plu.2.767c, Gal.10.693, al.: c. dat., Plu.2.353c, Gal.16.839

συνεπιφέρω.definition: carry with one, D.H.Lys.18; help to; of a term, carry along with it, i.e. imply, involve, Arist.Top.144b17, cf. 157b23, APr.52b7

συνεπιφθέγγομαι.definition: reinforce one's utterance, Id.Tim.27; sounds it with . . , Id.2.713a

συνεπιφορτίζω.definition: help to load still more, ib.728c

συνεπιφύομαι.definition: to be attached together with, Gal.2.446, 18.975

συνεπιφωνέω.definition: raise a shout of approval together, Aristeas235, 294

συνεπιχειρέω.definition: make an attempt together upon, Plb.3.84.1

σχίνινος.definition: made from mastich, Hp.Nat.Mul.109, Dsc.1.41, 70, Sor.1.121, etc

σχινοτρώκτης.definition: Dor. one who chews mastich-wood, to make his teeth white, Luc.Lex.12, Zen.5.96:—also Suid

σχοινιά.definition: clump or bunch of rushes; the wall of a city or part thereof, Str.8.6.21, dub. l. in CIG 2056g

σχοίνινος.definition: of rushes, made of rushes, E.Cyc.208; Id.Fr.284; Cratin.132; Ar.Fr.172; IG11.287 B 50 ; Str.12.5.4

σχοινίον.definition: Dim. of II, small rope, cord or; measuring-line, Arist.Mech.853b5, LXX2 Ki.8.2, OGI669.60 : hence

σχοινισμός.definition: measurement of land, PTeb.12.7, 61; = foreg. I, allotment, LXXJo.17.5

σχοινίων.definition: a bird, perh. =; an effeminate air on the flute, Plu.2.1132d,1133a, Poll.4.65,79

σχοινοβάτης.definition: rope-dancer, Cat.Cod.Astr.8.213, Man.4.287, Gloss.; Lat. schoenobates, Juv.3.77:—hence Ion. rope-dancing, interpol. in Hp.Vict.3.68; , Sch.D.T.p.110H

σχοινοειδής.definition: like a rope or cord, J.AJ12.2.9; Dsc.4.164

σχοινοπλόκος.definition: maker of rush-ropes or mats, Hp.Epid.4.2, Sch.Ar.Pax36, Suid

σχοινοτένεια.definition: poet.fem of sq., formed like of doubtful meaning, Pi.Fr.79A ; perh. moving straight forward, rather than prolix

σχοινοτενής.definition: stretched out like a; drawn in a straight line, Hdt.1.189,199; to draw a straight line, Id.7.23

σχοινότονος.definition: stretched with rushes or cords, Hp.Steril.230

σχοινοφόρος.definition: carrying rushes, cords, or mats, EM740.38

σχοινοχάλινος.definition: with rein of twisted rushes, Str.17.3.7

σχολάζω.definition: Boeot. IG7.2849.6 :—to; have rest or respite from a thing, cease from doing, X.Cyr.7.5.52; were set free from the operations at K., Id.HG7.4.28; also Plu.Nic.28

σχολαῖος.definition: leisurely, tardy, to go leisurely, Th.3.29; X.An.4.1.13; Hp.Dieb.Judic.10; Plu.2.603e. Adv. X.An.1.5.8, Arist.EN1171b24, etc.: Comp. Hdt.9.6; Th.4.47, Pl.R.610d: Sup. X.HG6.3.6; but also Id.An.1.5.9, Lac.11.3, Gal.6.3…

σχολαρχέω.definition: to be the head of a school, D.L.4.1, al

σχολάρχης.definition: head of a school, Id.5.2, PRyl.397.3

σχολαστήριον.definition: place for passing leisure in, Plu.Luc.42, Moschio ap.Ath.5.207e

Σωκράτης.definition: Socrates: gen. acc. sg. in Pl. , in X.Mem.1.2.33 voc. dear little Socrates! Ar.Nu.222, al

σωληνάριον.definition: Dim. of HeroSpir.1.10, al., Heliod. ap. Orib.50.9.8, Gal.10.1001, Alex.Trall.8.2

σωληνεύομαι.definition: Pass., to be carried round as in a pipe, EM385.27, Hsch

σωληνίδιον.definition: small groove, Ph.Bel.75.41; small pipe, Bito46.5, Gal.14.787

σωλήνιον.definition: Dim. of Bito46.4, Ph.Bel.75.46, Dsc.Eup.1.61, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.19.4

σωληνοειδής.definition: pipe-shaped, grooved, Aen.Tact.16.6, Ph.2.244, D.C.49.30. Adv. like a pipe, Ruf.Oss.24; groove-wise, Sor.1.85

σωμασκέω.definition: exercise the body, practise wrestling, etc., X.Cyr.1.6.17, 3.1.20, Plb.6.47.8, etc.; D.L.8.12: metaph., train War for action, Plu.Aem.8

σωμασκία.definition: bodily exercise, athletic training of the body, Pl.Phlb.30b, Lg.646d, 674b, X.Mem.3.9.11, Ph.2.8

σωμασκίας.definition: one who takes bodily exercise, Poll.3.154; glossed by Hdn.Epim.130

σωματέμπορος.definition: slave-dealer, Dsc.Eup.1.233, OGI524.5 , Artem.3.17, Cat.Cod.Astr.8.213, Eust.1416.26, Gloss

σωματηγέω.definition: carry a body, of saddle-mules, Hsch. s.v. Eust.1625.40

σωματίδιον.definition: Dim. of IV. 1, text of a document, PLips.11.14

σωμάτιον.definition: Dim. of small body, poor body; corpse, Plu.2.119b, Pap.inStud.Ital.12.99 , PLips.30.13 , Hdn.2.1.1

σωματισμός.definition: embodiment in a legal instrument; registration of liability to taxation, PFay.33.18 , PHamb. 11.11 : generally, registration, listing, PLond.3.604.3 ; BGU141 A 4

σωματοειδής.definition: bodily, corporeal, Pl.Phd.83d, 86a; incarnate, of a god, Ephor.31 J., Rev.Phil.1930.250

σωματομαχέω.definition: practise gymnastic exercises with an opponent, Gal.15.197

σωματοπλαστέω.definition: model a body, interpol. in Jul.Ep.89

σωματοποίησις.definition: the giving of bodily existence, Ptol.Tetr.105, Herm. ap. Stob.1.41.6

σωματουργέω.definition: = metaph., form into a whole, Procl.in Ti.2.71 D., al

σωματοφυλακέω.definition: to be a bodyguard, D.S.14.43: c. acc., J.AJ6.6.1, 11.3.1

σωματοφυλακία.definition: guarding the body or person, D.S.16.93, 17.65

σωματοφυλάκιον.definition: place where a body is guarded or kept, sepulchre, Luc.Cont.22

σωρίτης.definition: the fallacy of the heap, invented by Eubulides of Miletus. D.L.2.108, Cic.Acad.2.16.49, S.E.M.9.182, Asp.in EN56.34, Luc.Symp.23, Gal.8.25; title of work by Chrysipp., Stoic.2.6

σωσίοικος.definition: saving the house, Apollon.Lex. s.v. Hsch

σωσίπολις.definition: and saving the city, Ar.Ach.163; Str.14.1.41, cf. SIG589.48

σωστέος.definition: to be saved, Aristid.Or.24.37; one must save, E.HF1385; you must be saved, Ar.Lys.501.-- The form is cited by Hsch., Phot., Suid

σωτήριος.definition: saving, delivering; c. dat., bringing safety or deliverance to . . , Heraclit.61; A.Th.183, cf. Ch.505, E.Heracl.402, Ph.918; IG12 p.x : also c. gen., Pl.Ep.354b, cf. Arist.Pol.1314a13: Comp. and Sup., X.Mem.3.3.10; I…

σωφρονέω.definition: poet. Opp.H.3.446, AP5.301.11; come to one's senses, learn moderation, Hdt.3.64; A.Eu.521 ; ib.1000 ; S.Aj.1259; Id.Ph.1259; when he had recovered his senses, Pl.Phdr.241b

σωφρόνημα.definition: an example of self-control, X.Ages.5.4, Stoic.3.136; cf

σωφρονίζω.definition: recall a person to his senses, chasten; of passions, things, etc., Antipho2.3.3; X.Mem.2.1.16; to pant less violently, E.HF869 ; to reduce the expenses of government at home, Th.8.1

σωφρόνισμα.definition: chastisement, lesson, A.Supp.992, Aristarch. Trag.3 , App.Pun.78

σωφρονισμός.definition: teaching of morality or moderation, Str.1.2.3, J.BJ2.1.3, Plu.2.653d, etc.; self- control, 2 Ep.Ti.1.7

σωφρονιστήρ.definition: = Plu.Cat.Ma.27; at Thebes, which restored reason to Heracles, Paus.9.11.2

σωφρονιστής.definition: one that chastens or chastises; at Athens, superintendents of the youth in the gymnasia, 10 in number, IG22.1156, al., Arist.Ath.42.2, Pl.Ax.367a

σωφρονιστύς.definition: = for the sake of correction, Pl.Lg.934a

σώχω.definition: Ion. for rub to pieces, grind, Nic.Th.590, 696, Hsch.; cf

σεβομένως.definition: Adv. = Ammon.Diff.p.8V., but should be restd. from Ptol.Ascal.p.395H

σεσηρότως.definition: Adv. of ), with a grin, Poll.3.132

σεσοβημένως.definition: Adv. hurriedly, excitedly, Antyll. ap. Orib.10.3.9 , Anon.in Tht.10.34

σεσωφρονισμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. temperately, A.Supp.724

σῆκα.definition: Adv. into the fold , a shepherd's call to his flocks, Hsch

Σκυθιστί.definition: Adv. in Scythian fashion; in the Scythian tongue, Hdt.4.27,59, Parmeno1.2

σπειρηδόν.definition: Adv. in coils, Opp.H.1.516; of troops, in maniples, manipulatim, Plb.5.4.9, LXX2 Ma.5.2; Str.3.3.7

σποράδην.definition: Adv. scatteredly, here and there, Th.2.4 ; i.e. not in communities, Pl.Prt.322b, Isoc.4.39; Arist.Pol.1259a4; of Homer before Peisistratus, AP11.442; Plu.2.629e; opp. D.L.8.91

σπυριδόν.definition: Adv. in the form of a Sch.D.T.p.190 H.; cf

στελεχηδόν.definition: Adv. stem by stem, v.l. for A.R.1.1004

στιχηδόν.definition: Adv. in rows, Hdn.4.9.5, Sch.D.T.p.192 H

στρομβηδόν.definition: Adv. like a top, whirling, APl.4.300

συγκατατεθειμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass. of in an orderly way, Hsch. s.v

συγκεκροτημένως.definition: Adv. of in a finished way, Luc.Merc. Cond.35

συγκεχυμένως.definition: Adv. of indiscriminately, Arist.EN1145b16, Plu.2.168a, S.E.M.7.171, etc.; J.AJ13.4.4; Hermog.Id.1.11

συλλήβδην.definition: Adv. collectively, in sum, in short, Thgn.147 ; A.Pr.505; IG12.325.21; Ar.Pl.646; . . Id.V.657 ; . . Pl.Prt.324a, cf. 325c; Isoc.4.29; opp. , Pl.R.344b; opp. X.Oec.19.14

συμβεβηκότως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Act. of per accidens, Nicom.Ar.1.1, Syrian.in Metaph.169.24

συμμεμετρημένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass., in due proportion, Hp.Mochl.38, Poll.4.167

σύμπαντι.definition: Adv. in all, amounting to a total of, POxy.513.20

συμπεπλεγμένως.definition: Adv., complicatedly, Gal.19.489: c. dat., in conjunction with, Hermog.Stat.4

συμπερισπωμένως.definition: Adv. by reason of sharing the circumflex accent, A.D.Adv.175.23

συμπλήγδην.definition: Adv. with clapping of hands, Theoc.24.56

συμπληρωματικῶς.definition: Adv. by way of supplement, Sch.Od.8.567 ap.An.Par.3.457, Eust.ad D.P.41

συμφερόντως.definition: Adv. pres. part. , profitably, Antipho Soph.Oxy.1364.15 , Pl.Lg.662a, Isoc.2.25, cf. X.Mem.1.2.50, IG12.640.8 , etc.; on no plea either of justice or expediency, Antipho2.1.9; Isoc.8.137, cf. Demetr.Lac.Herc.1012.45

συνάμα.definition: Adv. for together, AP7.9 , Luc.Pisc.51, Bis Acc.11, etc.; with them, Theoc.25.126; freq. in tmesi: is dub.l. in S.Ichn.70

συναρμοττόντως.definition: Adv. pres. part. of sq., fittingly, Pl.Lg.967e

συναρχομένως.definition: Adv. with the same beginning, EM306.48, An.Ox.2.412

σύνεγγυς.definition: of Place, near, Hp.Art.41, Th.4.24, X.HG6.5.17, etc.; near at hand, PEnteux.27.5 ; quite close one to another, Arist.HA541a8, etc.; non-proximity, Id.Pol.1280b24; all his local interests, OGI229.94 : Sup. Plu.2.619d, …

συνεζευγμένως.definition: Adv. part. pf. Pass., by pairs, Sch.Ar.Av.305

συνεκδρομικῶς.definition: Adv. approximately, Sch.Iamb.in Nic.p.131 P., Sch.Th.1.10

συνεληλυθότως.definition: Adv., in company, dub. l. in Hsch. s.v

συνεπτυγμένως.definition: Adv., folded or taken together, Ps.-Alex. Aphr.in Metaph.467.3

συνεσκευασμένως.definition: Adv. by joint preparation, v.l. in X.Oec.11.19

συνεσπειραμένως.definition: Adv. in a concentrated form, Procl.in Prm.p.533 S., Id.in Ti.1.149 D.; opp. Herm.in Phdr.p.137 A.; ib.p.114 A

συνεσπουδασμένως.definition: Adv. with earnest zeal, Eun.VSp.468 B

συνεσταλμένως.definition: Adv., contractedly; Gramm., with a short vowel, Ath.3.106b, 9.393c

συνεστηκότως.definition: Adv., in a constrained way, Arist.Pol.1340b1

συνεστραμμένως.definition: Adv., as if twisted up, speak tersely, Arist.Rh.1401a5

συνηγμένως.definition: Adv., collectively, Hsch. s.v. An.Ox. 4.407, Tz.H.11.123, etc

συνηκολουθηκότως.definition: Adv. by way of consequence, consistently, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.257

συνημμένως.definition: Adv. of connectedly, Gal.19.84, Alex.Aphr.in Metaph.467.2, Gloss

συνηρημένως.definition: Adv., in general; by contraction, Hsch.s.v

συνηρτημένως.definition: Adv., in a trained manner, expertly, Phld.Rh.2.91 S

συντεταγμένως.definition: Adv., in set terms: v. sq

συντεταμένως.definition: Adv., earnestly, eagerly, vigorously, Ar.Pl.325, Pl.Ap.23e, R.499a, Phlb.59a

συνωχαδόν.definition: Adv., poet. for of Time, perpetually, continually, Hes.Th.690, Q.S.14.517.--On the form, v. A.D.Adv.196.14

Συριστί.definition: Adv. in the Syrian language, to understand Syrian, X.Cyr.7.5.31, cf. PPetr.3p.14 , Plu.Ant.46, Luc.Alex.51

σφαιρηδόν.definition: Adv.like a sphere, globe, or ball, Il.13.204, cf. AP6.45, Arat.531, Herod.Med. ap.Orib.8.7.3, Vett.Val.270.24

σφενδονηδόν.definition: Adv. like a sling, Sch.Il.11.165, EM738.25

σφόδρα.definition: Adv., properly neut. pl. of very; with Verbs, Hdt.9.17; S.El.1053; persuades them too well, Id.Aj.150 ; with vehemence, Antipho6.15; severely, Th.3.46; exactly, Pl.Phdr.263d, cf. Phlb.58d, Phd.68a, 73a; I am exceeding…

σχέδην.definition: Adv., gently, slowly; at close quarters, Anon. ap. Suid

σχεδόν.definition: Adv., : I. of Place, near, hard by, Ep. and Lyr., Il.10.100; Od.5.392, cf. 24.493; at close quarters, Il.5.458; 20.378, cf. 13.576, 16.828: sts. c. dat., 10.422; Od.9.23; Hes.Sc.113; so Pi.N.10.66 : more freq. c. gen.…

σχιδακηδόν.definition: Adv. splinter-wise, Dsc.5.106; esp. of fractures of the bones, Erot. s.v. Sor.Fract.10, Gal.10.424

σχοινοφιλίνδα.definition: Adv. a game somewhat like our hunt- the-slipper, Poll.9.115
